f8d3e75c81ec85edf532.description:
First Responder Wellness is seeking an organized, compassionate, and highly responsive Admissions Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of the Admissions Department. This position serves as an initial point of contact for prospective clients, families, first responder departments, peer-support teams, EAPs, and referral partners seeking information about treatment services.

The Admissions Coordinator manages incoming inquiries, gathers preliminary client and insurance information, coordinates admissions assessments, supports benefits verification, maintains accurate documentation, and facilitates communication throughout the admissions process.

The ideal candidate understands—or is eager to learn—the unique culture and needs of first responders and public safety professionals and can recognize situations requiring prompt escalation to clinical or admissions leadership.

**Schedule:** Flexible schedule, overtime opportunities may be available based on business needs.

**This position may be performed remotely. Candidates located in Orange County, CA will work from our Irvine office.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, texts, emails, website inquiries, and referrals.
* Serve as the initial point of contact for prospective clients, families, departments, peer-support representatives, EAPs, and referral partners.
* Gather demographic, behavioral health, substance use, treatment history, insurance, and referral information.
* Identify potential behavioral health, medical, safety, intoxication, or withdrawal concerns and escalate appropriately.
* Provide general information about programs, levels of care, admission requirements, expectations, and next steps within the scope of the role.
* Schedule comprehensive admissions assessments with Admissions Counselors and Sr. Admissions Counselors.
* Obtain insurance information and assist with verification of benefits.
* Coordinate with Admissions, Billing, Utilization Review, Clinical/Medical, and other departments as needed.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in Salesforce, the electronic health record, Call Tracking Metrics, and other systems.
* Conduct appropriate follow-up with prospective clients, families, and referral sources.
* Assist with admission dates, arrival information, transportation coordination, required documentation, and other logistics.
* Maintain continuity of communication when cases are transferred between team members or shifts.
* Provide appropriate non-clinical resources and referral information as directed.
* Maintain knowledge of behavioral health, substance use treatment, levels of care, insurance processes, and referral resources.
* Develop and demonstrate cultural competency related to first responders, public safety professionals, veterans, families, and peer-support teams.
* Maintain professional boundaries and distinguish admissions support from clinical assessment or treatment recommendations.
* Manage assigned leads, communications, tasks, and follow-up independently and effectively.
* Participate in required meetings, training, continuing education, and organizational activities.
* Maintain HIPAA compliance, confidentiality, professional boundaries, and ethical standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Experience in behavioral health, substance use treatment, healthcare admissions, intake, customer service, crisis services, or a related field preferred.
* Experience working independently in a remote environment preferred.
* Knowledge of behavioral health and/or substance use treatment preferred.
* Knowledge of first responder/public safety culture preferred; willingness to complete required cultural competency training required.
* Ability to complete required behavioral health, crisis recognition, first responder cultural competency, peer-support, and/or CISM training.
* Strong computer skills and ability to work across multiple electronic systems.
* Ability to maintain required organizational training and certifications.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent communication, telephone presence, and rapport-building skills.
* Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, leads, and communications simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently while recognizing when consultation or escalation is necessary.
* Sound judgment and ability to follow established admissions procedures.
* Cultural sensitivity when working with first responders, public safety professionals, veterans, families, and diverse populations.
* Ability to recognize potential behavioral health and safety concerns while remaining within role boundaries.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, EHR systems, Call Tracking Metrics, Microsoft Office/Outlook, and similar technology preferred.
* Knowledge of insurance verification and behavioral health benefits preferred.
* Dependability, professionalism, discretion, accountability, and commitment to confidentiality.

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Reliable high-speed internet/Wi-Fi and telephone access.
* Private, quiet, professional workspace suitable for confidential healthcare communications.
* Ability to maintain HIPAA-compliant privacy and information security.
* Reliable availability and responsiveness during scheduled working hours.
* Ability to independently manage time, workload, documentation, and follow-up.
* Ability to promptly communicate technology, internet, telephone, or environmental issues that affect job performance.

93d83b9017115bd9bcbe.title: Project Manager Operations Lead
93d83b9017115bd9bcbe.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

The Project Manager – TAP Operations Lead will serve as the day-to-day leader of TAP field operations, responsible for translating program requirements into effective staffing, scheduling, field execution, and operational controls. The Operations Lead will oversee workforce coverage and readiness, coordinate resources across locations, resolve operational issues, and help ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery.

The VA Transition Assistance Program (TAP) helps transitioning Service members and their families understand and access the VA benefits, services, and resources available to them as they transition from military to civilian life. VA delivers TAP services at more than 300 military installations across the Continental United States (CONUS) and areas Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) through a network of Benefits Advisors, supported by standardized curriculum, training, program operations, and performance management. The program is part of the broader interagency Transition Assistance Program delivered in partnership with the Department of War, Department of Labor, and other Federal agencies.

  

**Please note that this position is contingent upon award (estimated December 2026). We expect this role to be remote, but periodic travel may be required to support program activities, customer meetings, and operations at U.S. and overseas locations. Travel frequency will vary based on program needs.**

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Direct day-to-day operational execution of nationwide and OCONUS TAP field delivery across 300+ installations and a Benefits Advisor workforce of approximately 250-280 personnel.
* Maintain required Benefits Advisor staffing and operational coverage across permanent and itinerant locations, including continuity during vacancies, leave, training, and other staffing disruptions.
* Manage and coordinate regional/field leadership structures, personnel assignments, schedules, and operational priorities.
* Develop and issue operational directives, schedules, assignments, and implementation guidance necessary for consistent execution of Government requirements.
* Monitor vacancies, staffing levels, coverage requirements, attrition, onboarding, training status, and operational readiness; coordinate new-hire training needs with staffing forecasts.
* Coordinate field travel and temporary coverage while minimizing unnecessary temporary-duty travel and associated costs.
* Ensure timely event scheduling, operational reporting, and consistent delivery of VA Benefits and Services briefings and other required TAP support activities.
* Monitor installation-level service delivery, facilities, equipment, stakeholder relationships, and emerging issues that could affect performance.
* Track operational performance, risks, issues, staffing challenges, and corrective actions; escalate issues before they affect service delivery.
* Coordinate field activities with the Program Manager, Curriculum Lead, Data Analytics Lead, Government stakeholders, and installation-level partners.
* Support implementation of Government-approved operating procedures, curriculum changes, modernization initiatives, and program changes across the field organization.
* Maintain effective communications and knowledge sharing across geographically dispersed teams and locations.
* Ensure workforce onboarding, training, qualification, deployment, and continuing operational readiness.
* Contribute to weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc operational reports and Government briefings and support rapid response to Government requests.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience managing large-scale, geographically dispersed service-delivery operations involving workforce staffing, scheduling, coordination, and performance management.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing projects of national scope within the Federal Government or Department of War (DoW).
* Proven experience managing the day-to-day operations of a geographically dispersed workforce.
* Proven experience developing and issuing operational directives and schedules necessary to effectively manage program operations.
* Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting VA, DoW, military transition, Veteran services, training, or similarly complex Federal programs.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed service delivery across multiple military installations.
* Experience coordinating both CONUS and OCONUS operations.
* Experience managing workforce staffing, scheduling, vacancies, coverage, operational performance, and quality.
* Experience managing or supporting a Service Contract Act (SCA)-covered workforce.
* PMP or comparable project management certification.

### **Benefits (including but not limited to):**

* Health, dental, and vision plans
* Optional FSA
* Paid parental leave
* Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
* Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
* No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
* Pet insurance
* Monthly phone and internet stipend
* Tuition and training reimbursement

$120,000 - $135,000 a year

This range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as Trilogy Federal conducts an individual equity review for every candidate based on experience, location, education, industry experience, and comparisons to internal pay bands. In addition to salary, Trilogy offers robust benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance coverage, 401(k) match, paid holidays, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and a very supportive work/life balance.

92bbfaf85d9e9bfa87ae.title: Partnership Operations Specialist
92bbfaf85d9e9bfa87ae.description:
From Aisle to Algorithm and for All Life’s Moments, at David’s Bridal, we empower our customers and our employees to stay true to their dreams and find the one, whether that means the event or the wedding dress that matches a personal style—or the career that is a perfect fit. Join a company that dominates the products in their category – 1 out of 3 being sold by them and taking care of them with one of the highest customer service scores in retail!
  
If you are passionately enthusiastic, endlessly curious, and customer obsessed, say “I do” and apply today!
  
  
The Partnership Operations Specialist is an execution-focused role responsible for supporting the setup, launch, quality assurance, and ongoing operational maintenance of Enterprise Partnership programs.
  
This role will help move partners and initiatives from “ready to execute” to “live and functioning correctly,” ensuring products, assets, integrations, and digital experiences are set up accurately and issues are followed through to resolution.
  
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working across multiple systems, and persistent about closing the loop. This person does not need to technical but should be comfortable working within technology platforms, identifying issues, documenting them clearly, and partnering with IT and other internal teams to resolve them.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Marketplace & Partner Setup
  

* Support partner onboarding and product setup across Shopify Collective, Mirakl, and other current or future marketplace/dropship platforms
* Validate partner and product information prior to launch, including SKUs, pricing, product descriptions, imagery, links, inventory, and other required attributes
* Ensure products and partner experiences are configured correctly before being pushed live
* Maintain setup checklists and track outstanding requirements through completion

QA & Digital Experience
  

* Conduct pre- and post-launch QA of partner products and experiences on David’s Bridal digital properties
* Review product pages for accuracy, imagery, formatting, pricing, links, inventory availability, and overall customer experience
* Identify discrepancies between partner-provided information, system setup, and the live customer experience
* Document issues and coordinate corrections with the appropriate internal or external teams
* Perform recurring checks following launches and significant updates

Partnership Operations & Execution Support
  

* Provide flexible execution support across Enterprise Partnerships based on business priorities
* Coordinate collection and organization of partner assets, imagery, copy, and other required materials
* Support programming and QA of digital partnership activations, including e-spots and other promotional placements
* Pull and organize reporting or performance data for the Partnerships and Account Management teams
* Assist with partner launches, promotional updates, assortment changes, and other time-sensitive initiatives
* Maintain trackers, documentation, and status updates across multiple concurrent projects
* Take on additional operational projects as partnership models and business needs evolve

What Success Looks Like
  

* Partners move from setup to live status efficiently and accurately
* Products and partnership experiences launch with minimal errors
* Issues have clear ownership and are actively driven through resolution
* Partner feedback does not get lost between teams
* Marketplace and digital experiences are routinely validated after launch
* Account Managers spend less time chasing operational tasks and more time managing partner relationships and growing revenue
* Leadership has clear visibility into outstanding issues, dependencies, and launch status
* The role can flex across partnership initiatives as priorities change

Qualifications
  

* 2–4 years of experience in operations, eCommerce, marketplace support, project coordination, account support, merchandising operations, or a related field
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or errors
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to follow issues through to completion across multiple stakeholders
* Comfortable learning and working within multiple technology platforms
* Experience with Shopify, Mirakl, marketplace platforms, eCommerce systems, CMS tools, or ticketing systems preferred
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets and pulling, organizing, and validating data
* Strong written communication and documentation skills
* Able to work independently while knowing when an issue requires escalation

Now that we’ve popped the question, please say “I do”.
  
  
Full Time Opportunity – A comprehensive benefits package is available.
  

* Rewarding Environment and Competitive Pay
* Generous Dream Maker Discount After First Pay Period
* Referral Incentive Program
* Dayforce Wallet – Get Paid Early!
* Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
* 401K Program
* Paid Vacation, Wellness Days & Holidays, including your Birthday off!
* Pet Benefits

Love wins when love is for Everyone!
  
Our mission at David’s Bridal is to embrace the ideas of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. It is our goal to build a workforce that is as representative as the customers we serve. We vow to create a culture where all forms of diversity are celebrated and seen as valuable.
  
  
David’s Bridal encourages applications from all qualified candidates. David’s Bridal has a great record of accommodating persons with disabilities. Contact Human Resources at humanresources@dbi.com or 610.943.5048 if you need accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information on our accommodation policies.
  
  
**Policy:** Candidate Use of AI in Live Interviews
  
We conduct interviews to evaluate each candidate’s own knowledge, judgment, and communication. During any live interview (virtual or in-person), candidates must not use real-time generative AI tools to compose or feed their answers. Candidates may use assistive technologies (e.g., screen readers, live captions) and may request reasonable accommodation in advance.
  
  
**Disclaimer:** The preceding job description has been designed to highlight the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive description of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Actual duties and responsibilities will vary. The standard base pay range for this role is posted at a minimum and maximum rate.
  
  
The starting rate of pay offered will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, training, and/or experience, and internal equity. This base pay range is specific to the state this role is posted in and may not be applicable to other locations.
  
At David’s Bridal, it is rare for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range in their role, but instead closer to the midpoint of the posted range, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the details and circumstances of each position and candidate.

70b1adb1b0d97b39a34f.title: Principal Cloud Operations Manager
70b1adb1b0d97b39a34f.description:
**Why AIS?**
============

When you join AIS, you’re joining a mission-driven team that’s passionate about making a difference. You’ll work on projects that matter, alongside industry-leading experts, in an environment that fosters innovation, driving client success, and empowering our team to make a lasting impact. As an employee-owned company, we value collaboration, inclusivity, continuous growth, and shared success.

* **Employee Ownership** : Your contributions directly impact the company’s success, and you share in its achievements.
* **Continuous Learning** : Access to resources, training, and mentorship to support your professional growth.
* **Inclusive Culture** : A workplace where diversity is celebrated, and everyone’s voice is valued.
* **Mission-Driven Work** : Engage in projects that make a meaningful difference for our clients and communities.

**What are we looking for?**
============================

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

**Working@AIS**
===============

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Director of Operations.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Principal Cloud Operations Manager.



**Project Summary**
===================

Lead enterprise-scale Operations & Maintenance (O&M) services for a large Defense Industrial Base customer operating Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. This is a junior-executive-level, customer-facing leadership position accountable for service performance, operational maturity, customer confidence, and successful transition of new capabilities into steady-state operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Own end-to-end operational performance and enterprise service outcomes across Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management, collaboration, messaging, security, and related cloud platforms.
* Lead, develop, and align a growing multidisciplinary organization of engineers, administrators, technical leads, and support professionals, scaling to support an organization of more than 100 team members.
* Establish and drive a data-driven operational model leveraging SLAs, KPIs, MTTA/MTTR, backlog aging, incident trends, reopen rates, service health, customer satisfaction, and capacity planning measures.
* Serve as the primary executive-facing operational leader, proactively identifying risks, anticipating customer needs, communicating service health in business terms, and recommending solutions before issues escalate.
* Manage multiple concurrent priorities including major incidents, operational risks, workforce capacity, service transitions, customer escalations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure disciplined incident and problem management practices by overseeing root cause analysis, corrective action plans, accountability tracking, due dates, and measurable reduction in recurring issues.
* Own the operational readiness and service transition framework, ensuring new services are successfully integrated into production operations and support environments.
* Partner with project managers, architects, engineers, security teams, service owners, and customer stakeholders to define operational acceptance criteria for new and enhanced services.
* Lead formal Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and provide risk-based recommendations regarding service acceptance and production deployment readiness.
* Validate that all operational prerequisites are in place prior to service acceptance, including support ownership models, RACI definitions, escalation procedures, monitoring and alerting capabilities, ServiceNow integration, runbooks/SOPs/ knowledge management documentation, access model, SLA/KPIs, staffing requirements, business continuity plans, and security/compliance evidence.
* Establish remediation plans and transition-risk mitigation strategies when operational exceptions are required, while measuring post-transition stability and incorporating lessons learned into future service onboarding activities.
* Provide technical leadership and operational oversight across Microsoft cloud technologies, including Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and core Azure infrastructure services.
Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, assess operational risk, contribute to architecture reviews, and lead technical discussions during incidents and service lifecycle planning.  

  

**Required For This Opportunity**
=================================

* 10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT operations, managed services, cloud operations, infrastructure operations, or service delivery; 5+ years in senior leadership with direct accountability for production service outcomes.
* Documented responsibility for an enterprise environment of at least 10,000 users.
* Demonstrated leadership of a large technical organization of approximately 50+ engineers, administrators, support personnel, or equivalent multidisciplinary delivery staff.
* Proven data-driven management: personally used operational metrics to set priorities, manage performance, identify systemic issues, allocate capacity, and drive measurable service improvement.
* Direct ownership of SLAs/KPIs, service reviews, major incidents, escalations, backlog, corrective actions, and continuous improvement—not merely project coordination or status reporting.
* Significant experience transitioning new technology services from project delivery into production O&M, including operational acceptance criteria, readiness reviews/service acceptance, risk disposition, and post-transition stabilization.
* Meaningful technical leadership experience with both Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 in production enterprise environments.
* Executive-level customer experience, including regular briefings to director/VP/CIO/CISO or equivalent stakeholders and demonstrated ability to anticipate customer needs.
* Experience in federal, defense, DIB, aerospace, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment and practical use of ServiceNow.
* Deep understanding of change management concepts, processes, and risk management.
* Demonstrated ability to manage several high-priority operational, technical, customer, and organizational efforts concurrently without losing ownership or follow-through.
* Willingness and ability to travel on-site for up to one week per quarter (approximately four weeks per year).
* Must not be a current owner/operator, founder, or active managing partner of a managed service provider (MSP).
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).
Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900), earned before the exam retirement date, or AB-900.  

  

**Nice to Have Skills**
=======================

* Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102) or other advanced Microsoft role-based certification; HDI Support Center Manager/Director; Security+, CISSP, CISM, or CCSP.
* GCC High and/or Azure Government experience; CUI, ITAR, NIST 800-171, CMMC, or comparable compliance-driven operations.
* Experience leading geographically distributed teams, subcontractors, vendors, or multiple delivery organizations within one managed service.




**Managing@AIS**
================

As an AIS People Manager, your responsibilities will include:

* **Coaching:** Helping employees navigate challenges, strengthen relationships, and grow the skills that support success at AIS.
* **Career Development** : Supporting employees in exploring growth opportunities at AIS and aligning development plans to reach their goals.
* **Performance Management** : Creating clarity through clear expectations, regular feedback, and proactive support when performance concerns arise.
* **Accountability and Results** : Holding employees accountable for meeting expectations, delivering results, and adhering to company policies and values.
* **Promotions and Compensation** : Partnering with HR to evaluate and recommend promotions, salary adjustments, and rewards that reflect performance and potential.
* **Timecard Approval** : Ensuring accurate and timely approval of timecards.


At AIS, we are committed to offering competitive and fair compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and contributions of each team member.

The targeted base salary range for this role is $165,000-$248,000 per year. Please note that this range is provided as a guideline and the final offer will be based on several factors, including but not limited to, skillset and competencies, level of experience, education, certifications, and location.

We value transparency in our hiring process and are happy to discuss how your unique qualifications align with our compensation structure during the interview process.

47dfdcb64a209a48667f.title: Executive Operations Coordinator
47dfdcb64a209a48667f.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

Extreme Hospitality is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful **Executive Operations Coordinator** to work directly with the company's C-suite executives, providing comprehensive executive support while assisting with a diverse range of corporate initiatives, operational activities, and special projects.

This is not a traditional administrative-only position. We are looking for a dynamic individual who enjoys wearing multiple hats, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is equally comfortable managing executive calendars, coordinating company events, preparing professional presentations, conducting research, and helping execute strategic initiatives.

The position will also provide cross-functional support across the organization, assisting with financial and operational reporting, performance analysis, commercial initiatives, and coordination between corporate departments and hotel teams.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted resource to executive leadership, helping keep priorities organized, projects moving forward, and daily business activities running efficiently.

This position offers meaningful exposure to senior leadership, hotel operations, business development, and the strategic activities of a growing national hospitality organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the company's C-suite executives.
* Manage executive calendars, coordinate meetings, schedule appointments, and assist with prioritizing competing commitments.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, transportation, itineraries, and related logistics.
* Prepare meeting agendas, briefing materials, correspondence, and follow-up communications.
* Assist with expense reporting, document organization, recordkeeping, and other administrative functions.
* Monitor assigned action items, follow up on outstanding requests, and help ensure executive priorities remain on track.
* Serve as a liaison between executive leadership, corporate departments, property-level teams, ownership groups, and external business partners.
* Maintain the highest level of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive business information.

### **Special Projects & Business Support**

* Support executive leadership on a broad range of special projects, strategic initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct research, gather information, and prepare summaries, reports, and business analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Assist in developing professional PowerPoint presentations, proposals, financial summaries, reports, and other executive-level materials.
* Compile, organize, and analyze financial, operational, and performance data to support corporate initiatives and business objectives.
* Assist with routine financial administration, reporting, expense tracking, and coordination of information between corporate departments and property-level teams.
* Support the preparation and coordination of business plans, budgets, forecasts, and periodic performance reporting.
* Assist with research, data collection, and reporting related to market trends, competitive positioning, business performance, and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate project timelines, track deliverables, and follow up with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
* Assist with business development activities, including preparation of materials, research, and coordination of meetings and presentations.
* Take ownership of assigned ad hoc projects and help drive them through completion.

### **Hotel Operations & Corporate Initiatives**

* Assist corporate leadership in coordinating new hotel management transitions, onboarding activities, and other operational initiatives.
* Support communication and coordination between corporate departments and hotel property teams.
* Help organize project information, track deadlines, and monitor key deliverables associated with hotel transitions and special assignments.
* Assist with gathering, organizing, and distributing hotel performance information, operational reports, and other key business metrics.
* Coordinate periodic reporting, meetings, and follow-up activities involving corporate leadership and property-level teams.
* Assist with cross-functional initiatives involving hotel operations, finance, sales, marketing, and other corporate disciplines.
* Support the execution and tracking of initiatives designed to improve hotel performance, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.
* Participate in select property visits, corporate meetings, and other business activities as needed.

### **Meetings, Events & Travel Coordination**

* Assist in planning and executing corporate meetings, leadership conferences, retreats, and company events.
* Coordinate meeting venues, accommodations, transportation, catering, and related logistics.
* Prepare schedules, agendas, presentation materials, and attendee communications.
* Support executive travel and event participation, including occasional travel to company properties and industry functions.
* Coordinate with hotels, vendors, and external partners to ensure successful execution of meetings and events.
* Help ensure a professional, organized, and seamless experience for attendees and participants.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience in an executive support, administrative, project coordination, business operations, or similar professional role.
* Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to draft polished business correspondence and professional reports.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical aptitude, comfort working with numbers, and the ability to organize and interpret business information.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a high level of professionalism.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate needs, solve problems, and take initiative without constant direction.
* Comfort working in a dynamic environment where priorities and assignments may change quickly.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion with sensitive information.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 10% of the time.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Progressive experience in business administration, hospitality management, communications, finance, or a related field.
* Experience supporting senior executives or C-suite leadership.
* Background in hospitality, real estate, professional services, or another fast-paced, service-oriented industry.
* Experience preparing executive presentations, business reports, financial summaries, or analytical materials.
* Familiarity with financial reporting, budgeting processes, business performance metrics, or operational analysis.
* Experience with project management, event planning, or operational coordination.
* Interest in leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled productivity tools to improve efficiency and streamline business processes.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Beyond experience and qualifications, we are looking for someone with the right attitude, work ethic, and approach to their responsibilities.

Our ideal candidate is:

* **A versatile team player:** Willing and able to jump between administrative responsibilities, analytical assignments, operational projects, and whatever else the day may bring.
* **A self-starter:** Someone who identifies what needs to be done, takes initiative, and follows through without requiring constant direction.
* **Resourceful and solutions-oriented:** Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics, finding answers, and developing practical solutions.
* **Detail-oriented:** Capable of managing the small details while understanding broader business objectives.
* **Adaptable:** Energized by variety, new challenges, and changing priorities.
* **Analytically minded:** Comfortable working with spreadsheets, reports, financial information, and business performance data.
* **Professional and personable:** Confident communicating with executives, hotel owners, business partners, and team members at all levels.
* **Accountable and dependable:** Takes ownership of assignments, meets deadlines, and consistently delivers high-quality work.
* **Eager to learn and grow:** Interested in gaining exposure to different aspects of the business and taking on increasing responsibilities over time.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

Extreme Hospitality offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications
* Employer-sponsored health insurance benefits
* Employer-sponsored 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Hotel employee discounts and travel-related benefits
* Company-paid business travel expenses
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

**Why Join Extreme Hospitality?**
---------------------------------

At Extreme Hospitality, the Executive Operations Coordinator position offers an opportunity to do much more than manage schedules and administrative tasks.

You will work directly with senior leadership, gain firsthand exposure to the hospitality industry, participate in meaningful corporate projects, and contribute to the continued growth of an entrepreneurial organization.

No two days will look exactly alike. From supporting executive priorities and coordinating corporate events to assisting with hotel transitions, business reporting, and strategic initiatives, you will have the opportunity to make an impact across multiple areas of the company.

For someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in being the person others can count on, and wants to build a career with a growing company, this role offers an opportunity for professional growth and meaningful involvement in the business.

22c1e9f37ee845565933.title: Payroll & Staff Accountant / HR Coordinator
22c1e9f37ee845565933.description:
**Company Description**

**"*****Why work for Accor?***  
*We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.*  
*By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/*  
***Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS"***

***Hotel Description***

*Located in prestigious Rittenhouse Square, the AAA rated 4-diamond Sofitel – Philadelphia, boasts 306 beautifully appointed guestrooms, featuring Lanvin amenities, dream bedding and a luxurious atmosphere. We will be your personal culinary connoisseurs, offering our classic, French inspired menu, made from the freshest ingredients harvested directly from our rooftop garden. Enjoy our signature hand-crafted cocktails in Liberté Lounge, the “in-place” to gather and mingle for Philly’s finest clientele.*

*Our team of highly trained Ambassadors are at your service, ready to provide a magnifique and memorable experience.*

***Joie de Vivre is in our DNA, and we are seeking like-minded individuals to join our team!***

 **Job Description**

Join our Finance team and help deliver accurate payroll, meaningful labor reporting, and a positive experience for our Heartists®.

Working closely with Finance, People & Culture, and department leaders, you will play an essential role in coordinating our biweekly payroll process, supporting accounting and HR administration, and assisting with the implementation of an upcoming payroll system upgrade. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented and goal-driven individual who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in achieving results, and is passionate about improving processes and creating greater efficiency. You will also serve as a trusted resource for our Heartists and leaders, providing support with care, professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion.

**What’s in it for you:**

* Employee benefit card offering discounted rates at Accor hotels worldwide.
* Learning and development opportunities through our Academies.
* Opportunities to grow within our hotel and across the Accor network.
* Opportunities to make a difference through our sustainability and community initiatives.

**Payroll Administration & Compliance**

* Coordinate accurate and timely biweekly payroll processing for all hotel employees, obtaining required documentation and approvals before submission.
* Review timekeeping records, missed punches, overtime, paid time off, pay adjustments, deductions, and applicable tips and service charge allocations.
* Partner with department leaders to resolve payroll discrepancies and respond promptly and confidentially to employee questions.
* Maintain complete payroll records and supporting documentation in accordance with company policies, Focus Audit requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Audit schedule changes for Philadelphia Fair Workweek compliance, verify predictability pay calculations and documented exceptions, and ensure approved payments are included in payroll.
* Identify recurring payroll and scheduling issues, escalate findings, and follow up on corrective actions with Finance and Talent & Culture.

**Payroll System Upgrade**

* Serve as the hotel’s payroll coordination contact during the deployment of the payroll and timekeeping system upgrade.
* Support data validation, earning and deduction code mapping, accrual balances, reporting requirements, and approval workflows.
* Participate in user testing and parallel payroll reconciliations to identify discrepancies before launch.
* Help prepare procedures and training materials, assist department leaders with adoption, and track issues through resolution after launch.

**Labor Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare and distribute accurate daily labor reports and weekly payroll summaries.
* Compare actual and scheduled hours and labor costs against budget, forecast, and business volumes.
* Highlight overtime, agency labor, predictability pay, and other significant variances for management review.
* Work with department leaders to improve reporting accuracy and support informed staffing decisions.

**Staff Accounting Support**

* Prepare payroll journal entries, payroll accruals, and related balance sheet reconciliations.
* Support month-end closing and other duties as assigned by ensuring payroll expenses are accurately recorded and allocated by department.
* Assist with accounts receivable, accounts payable, income audit, inventory management, account reconciliations, and other accounting duties as assigned.
* Review daily operations audit packets, investigate missing documentation or discrepancies, and support compliance with internal controls.
* Assist with payment processing and management of hotel insurance and benefit programs (transit, 401k, etc.)

**HR Coordination**

* Assist with the maintenance, organization, and periodic auditing of employee personnel files to ensure records are complete, accurate, and compliant with company requirements.
* Assist with HR compliance reporting and data reconciliation in collaboration with Payroll and HR systems.
* Serve as a point of contact and liaison between Heartists, leaders, Payroll, and People & Culture regarding payroll and HR-related questions and concerns.
* Support the communication and implementation of HR policies, procedures, and updates, particularly those impacting payroll, timekeeping, scheduling, and HR systems.
* Assist with monitoring HR and payroll-related deadlines, follow-ups, and required documentation to ensure timely completion.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy when handling employee information, payroll-related matters, and personnel records.
* Provide administrative support to the People & Culture team on HR projects, audits, employee communications, and other departmental initiatives as needed.

 **Qualifications**

**Your experience and skills include:**

* Previous experience working in a hotel strongly preferred
* At least two years of relevant payroll and accounting experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment.

* Experience processing payroll and reconciling timekeeping and payroll data.
* Understanding of payroll controls, wage and hour requirements, and confidential employee record handling.
* Familiarity with Philadelphia Fair Workweek requirements and predictability pay auditing preferred.
* Experience with Dayforce or a comparable payroll and HR system; system implementation or upgrade experience is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and month-end closing.
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and ability to meet recurring deadlines.
* Strong communication skills and a service-oriented approach to supporting employees and department leaders.
* Previous HR coordination experience preferred.
* Experience with Opera Cloud and Silverware is an advantage.
* A degree or coursework in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

  
**Additional Information**

**Your team and working environment:**

* Be part of an influential team to guide the transformation of luxury, French hospitality.
* We recognize and celebrate team and individual successes.
* We are a brand influenced by French indulgence offering a genuine experience of art de vivre for both employees and guests.

**Staffing Coordinator**

**Schedule:** 9 AM to 5 PM - Full time

**About Us**

At Granny’s Helping Hand, we are dedicated to providing compassionate, reliable, and professional care to our clients and their families. We’re looking for a **Staffing Coordinator** who will play a vital role in ensuring clients receive consistent, high-quality care through effective scheduling and strong administrative support.

**Position Summary**

The Staffing Coordinator is responsible for the accurate and timely coordination of Consumer and Direct Care Worker (DCW) schedules, staffing coverage, calendar management, communication, and real-time monitoring of service delivery. The position serves as a key liaison among Consumers, DCWs, family caregivers, the in-house Case Manager, Consumer Advocate, Service Coordinators, and other appropriate stakeholders.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Manage Consumer and Direct Care Worker schedules, including open shifts, call-outs, vacations, and last-minute staffing needs.
* Communicate with Consumers, Direct Care Workers, families, and internal team members regarding schedules, staffing changes, and service needs.
* Monitor schedules and Electronic Visit Verification activity for missed shifts, uncovered hours, late arrivals, and clock-in/clock-out discrepancies.
* Coordinate with the Case Manager to support client needs, continuity of care, and timely resolution of scheduling concerns.
* Participate in Direct Care Worker interviews, discuss assignment expectations, and assist with caregiver matching based on client needs.
* Identify and communicate Direct Care Worker training, coaching, or support needs to the appropriate supervisor.
* Maintain accurate scheduling, staffing, and communication records in company systems.
* Escalate service interruptions, changes in client needs, and other concerns as needed while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.

**Qualifications**

* **Education/Experience:** High School diploma or GED required
* **At least 1 year of home care staffing and scheduling experience**; preferably with experience staffing Medicaid waiver clients.
* **Language Skills:** Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact professionally with caregivers, consumers, families, and office staff.
* **Computer Skills:** Proficient in email, word processing, spreadsheets, databases, HHAeXchange, EVV (Electronic Visit Verification), and navigating company-specific software. Experience monitoring clock-ins/clock-outs, identifying missed or incorrect visits, and understanding how EVV affects scheduling, payroll, and billing.
* **Other Qualifications:** Strong organizational skills, detail-oriented, and effective at maintaining accurate staffing and scheduling documentation. Ability to manage information storage and retrieval and communicate effectively regarding scheduling and coverage needs.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Make a Difference Every Day:** Help make a real difference in the lives of clients and their families.
* **Be Part of a Great Team:** Work alongside a supportive, collaborative team that values communication and teamwork.
* **Grow Your Skills:** Gain valuable experience in scheduling, client support, and administrative work within a healthcare setting.
* **No Two Days Are Exactly the Same:** Stay engaged with a role that keeps you connected to clients, caregivers, families, and your team.
* **Build a Career You Can Be Proud Of:** Develop your skills, take on new challenges, and grow with a company that values the work you do.

**Ready to make a difference while building your career? We’d love to meet you! If you’re organized, people-oriented, and ready to jump in and make an impact, apply today and let’s get started!**

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

Like other managers at GitLab, you'll see your team as your product. You'll spend your time hiring and developing world-class Support Engineers who deliver exceptional technical support while continuously improving how your team solves problems. GitLab is working through it’s own AI transformation so you’ll be a leader in designing and implementing AI strategy for our Support team. As a Support Manager, you shape the customer support experience in your region. You'll balance direct customer relationships with the work of scaling your team, improving internal processes, adopting AI, and collaborating across departments to ship tools and solutions that make support more efficient. You'll help your team become self-sufficient, take ownership of complex issues from initial contact through resolution, and create a psychologically safe environment where people grow.

Some examples of our projects:

* A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
* A solution that captures the state of a customer's server for easier troubleshooting
* A tool that turns log files into interactive tables so you can easily sort and filter columns
* Functionality for ChatOps that makes it easier to identify user accounts on the GitLab.com platform

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Partner with other support managers to hire and maintain a world-class Support Engineering team focused on delivering excellent technical support to GitLab's customers.
* Develop your team members' technical skills and experience through mentorship, structured training, and career growth opportunities.
* Drive team ownership by fostering self-sufficiency, accountability, and alignment with key performance indicators.
* Build scalable processes and workflows that enable your team to collaborate effectively and execute with excellence.
* Conduct regular 1:1s with all team members to support their growth, address challenges, and create psychological safety.
* Train Support Engineers to conduct high-quality technical interviews, strengthening your hiring pipeline.
* Partner across GitLab to deepen understanding of customer needs and business goals, informing product and support improvements.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the customer experience through measurable, repeatable solutions.
* Document how the team works and find ways to make it more efficient through tools, process changes, and automation. Use AI well in your own work and coach your team to do the same.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Ability to create and implement processes and procedures that improve team efficiency.
* Ability to provide technical customer support and manage the full support lifecycle, from understanding customer needs and initial engagement through resolution, in collaboration with development.

We are distributed globally across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions and own the customer support experience for GitLab. We work on support tickets, dig into code and logs to troubleshoot issues, and collaborate across departments to resolve customer challenges. Our team operates asynchronously with regular pairing sessions, one-on-ones, and Slack conversations that keep us connected. We create an environment where Support Engineers can grow and do their best work. We build processes that balance customer needs with team wellbeing, recognizing that a healthy customer experience comes from a healthy team. For more on how our team works, see the Support team handbook page

Talkiatry is seeking a **Senior Program Manager, Clinical Recruitment Marketing & Events** to sit at the intersection of Marketing and Talent Acquisition, driving the strategy and execution of national psychiatrist and Advanced Practice Provider (APP) recruitment events. This role builds trust-based relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs, including program directors, faculty, and trainees, across the country, translating those relationships into a strong pipeline of clinicians who will join Talkiatry post-training.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role for someone who combines event strategy, marketing execution, and recruitment expertise to deliver measurable outcomes that support clinical excellence and organizational growth.

**About Talkiatry:**
--------------------

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

  

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 800+ psychiatrists, 300+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

  

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

### **Residency and Fellowship Program Outreach and Events**

* Serve as a brand ambassador for Talkiatry; engage trainees and build relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs nationwide, including program directors, faculty, program coordinators, chief residents, and chief fellows.
* Build and grow a national footprint of target programs, prioritizing outreach based on program size, specialty focus (e.g., child & adolescent, addiction, forensic psychiatry), and geography.
* Plan and execute dinners, social events, and virtual events for residents and fellows, and deliver ongoing clinical education and clear introductions to Talkiatry's practice management model, incentives, and a transition-to-practice pathway for those nearing graduation.
* Articulate Talkiatry's mission and core values in ways that resonate with program leaders.
* Maintain long-term relationships with program leaders to support annual visits (virtual or in person) and serve as a consistent, credible point of contact throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Use various tools and databases to connect with residency/fellowship program contacts, and track all contacts and outreach in the ATS/CRM.
* Collaborate with marketing on presentation materials, collateral, and e-invites.
* Own full-cycle event planning and track fiscal activities associated with each event.
* Attend residency and fellowship events as needed.

### **Networking Event Planning for Practicing Providers**

* Plan and execute virtual career/open house events:

  + Partner with marketing on content development and preparation.
  + Drive event advertising and psychiatrist outreach via social media, email blasts, etc.
  + Create event invitations and manage registration.
  + Ensure the technology platform is arranged and functioning.
  + Staff events with members of the Talkiatry clinical team.
* Plan and execute in-person networking events, some of which are associated with conferences.
* Track fiscal activities associated with each event.
* Attend conferences as needed.

### **Conference and Event Strategy & Execution**

* Conceptualize event themes and formats tailored to each psychiatry residency/fellowship program's needs and goals.
* Manage end-to-end event logistics: timelines, technical coordination, budgets, vendor engagement, and contract negotiation.
* Plan and execute exhibiting at various conferences each year.
* Manage the scheduling, agenda development for attending staff, documentation, and tracking of each event's action items, including booth selection and payment, ordering of swag, display materials, lead retrieval, booth essentials, catering, packing, and shipping, and marketing and outreach for events.
* Track fiscal activities associated with each event.
* Prepare post-event expenditure and outcomes reporting to track ROI and inform future event strategy.
* Consistently exceed the annual goal of 30+ successful events per year, while identifying opportunities to scale further.

### **Marketing & Brand Presence**

* Develop marketing assets and social media content that support event promotion and brand visibility within the clinical/residency community.
* Partner with the marketing team on copywriting, scripting, and editing for recruitment and brand campaigns.

### **Cross-Functional Recruitment Support**

* Partner closely with clinical leadership and the National Residency Team to align event strategy with recruitment goals and generate high-quality psychiatrist and APP candidates.
* Apply recruiter-level knowledge to build lasting candidate relationships, guiding residents and fellows through interviewing, contracting, and onboarding, and remaining a point of contact for ongoing support.
* Source and support outreach for psychiatry residency and fellowship program educational and outreach events.

### **Flexible, Company-Wide Support**

* Flex across departments during periods of high demand, assisting with company-wide marketing, job board management, invoicing, and contract renewals.
* Maintain continuous communication with vendor representatives and recruitment management teams to ensure alignment.

**Role Requirements:**
----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, Business, Human Resources, or a related field required, or commensurate experience.
* Minimum of 6-8 years of experience in talent attraction, with at least 2 of those years spent in trainee outreach (e.g., residency/fellowship, early-career, or campus recruiting), healthcare, physician recruitment, or clinical/medical education experience strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), CRM/database tools, and standard office software (Microsoft Office / Google Workspace).
* Ability to travel up to 30% of the time, including overnight and multi-day trips to conferences and residency/fellowship programs nationwide.
* Availability to work occasional evenings and weekends to support events.

**You'll Be Successful If You:**
--------------------------------

* Have a proven track record in physician and/or APP recruitment, ideally within psychiatry, behavioral health, or a related clinical field, and enjoy building and maintaining relationships with physicians.
* Have demonstrated success in strategic event design and management, including budget ownership and vendor/contract negotiation.
* Have experience building relationships with clinical stakeholders- residents, fellows, program directors, faculty, and clinical leadership, ideally within psychiatry residency or fellowship programs.
* Are proficient with talent acquisition platforms like LinkedIn, PracticeMatch, other job boards, and applicant tracking systems.
* Have a proven track record of delivering data-driven insights and translating those into recommendations.
* Have strong project management skills; able to juggle multiple events, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously, and multitask under deadlines.
* Have a high level of attention to detail.
* Are marketing-fluent; comfortable with social media, content development, and campaign copy.
* Have excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent the organization at conferences and tradeshows.
* Have excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop productive working relationships across a diverse spectrum of internal and external stakeholders, exhibit sensitivity, and appreciate cultural differences.
* Claim ownership and responsibility on projects to achieve your goals; you take initiative.
* Are a confident problem solver who can act decisively and calmly, and who is resourceful, creative, and flexible when priorities shift in a fast-paced environment.
* Are willing and able to travel frequently (regional/national).
* Prior recruiting experience strongly preferred ; a background as a clinical or physician recruiter is a significant plus.

**What Success Looks Like:**
----------------------------

* A robust, warm pipeline of psychiatry residents and fellows actively engaged with Talkiatry ahead of graduation.
* Rolodex/Contact database of all trainees in Psychiatry, across programs in the U.S.
* High-quality events delivered annually on budget and on strategy, resulting in leads, both warm and longer-term relationships.
* Strong, durable relationships with psychiatry residency and fellowship programs that make Talkiatry a repeat, trusted partner.
* Seamless collaboration between Marketing and Talent Acquisition, with each function reinforcing the other.

**Why Talkiatry:**

d1cb7cb5c3f6f03d15b0.title: Director of Installation & Market Operations – Northeast
d1cb7cb5c3f6f03d15b0.description:
Express Flooring is expanding into the Northeast, and this role will build the operating foundation behind that growth.

The **Director of Installation & Market Operations** will lead installation execution, satellite operations, and market performance across the region. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this leader will develop Market Operations Managers, local operations teams, and residential flooring installer networks capable of supporting both new and established markets.

Success in this role means having the right leaders and installer capacity in place, keeping projects moving from material receipt through installation and closeout, and holding each market accountable for quality, customer experience, and financial performance. If you're a hands-on operator who knows how to build disciplined teams and scale multi-site operations, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Express Flooring grows throughout the Northeast.

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote, located in the North East and will have required travel  
**Compensation:** $150-175k + Bonus  
**Reports To:** Chief Operating Officer

**What You'll Do**

**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead and develop Market Operations Managers through clear expectations, operating reviews, field visits, action plans, and consistent follow-through.
* Build a strong regional leadership bench and partner with Talent Acquisition to recruit, onboard, develop, retain, and manage performance across local operations teams.

**Installation Execution and Installer Network**

* Own installation production from project readiness and scheduling through crew assignment, completion, documentation, and job closeout.
* Maintain installer capacity by market and product category through disciplined recruiting, qualification, onboarding, engagement, performance management, and retention.
* Set standards for workmanship, professionalism, customer communication, jobsite conduct, and compliance while addressing trends in cancellations, incomplete installations, warranty claims, credits, compensation, and chargebacks.

**Satellite Operations and Material Readiness**

* Oversee material receipt, storage, project staging, installer load-out, returns, transfers, and reconciliation across satellite locations.
* Maintain inventory discipline and partner with Distribution to resolve shortages, damage, missing items, and transaction errors before they disrupt scheduled installations.
* Establish standards for facility organization, material handling, equipment, access, security, and operational readiness in partnership with Real Estate and other support teams.

**Customer and Financial Performance**

* Ensure timely customer communication and own installation-related escalations and service recovery across assigned markets.
* Use complaints, reviews, warranty activity, and customer feedback to identify root causes and improve market-level execution.
* Manage performance against production, quality, installer capacity, labor, material loss, safety, revenue, expense, profitability, and capital targets.

**Northeast Expansion and Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead operational readiness for new Northeast markets, including local leadership, installer capacity, training, systems, facilities, workflows, and go-live execution.
* Develop contingency plans for leadership, installers, materials, customer communication, and service performance during market ramp-up.
* Partner across Sales, Customer Service, Order Processing, Ratings and Reputation, Distribution, Purchasing, Finance, IT, HR, Real Estate, and Expansion to support reliable execution and regional growth.

**Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with company safety standards and applicable warehouse, vehicle, equipment, employment, and contractor requirements.
* Maintain effective incident-response practices and protect company assets and customer property through disciplined controls, documentation, and escalation procedures.

**What You'll Bring**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in multi-site installation, field service, market operations, home services, or a related operating environment.
* Proven success leading multiple locations and developing market leaders, coordinators, and field teams at scale.
* Experience building and managing subcontractor or independent installer networks, including capacity planning, recruiting, onboarding, quality, performance, and retention.
* Experience overseeing satellite or branch operations, material control, scheduling, service recovery, safety, and new-market launches.
* A track record of improving production, quality, customer satisfaction, service costs, and profitability.
* Strong financial judgment with experience managing operating budgets, labor, service costs, credits, and market profitability.
* The ability to analyze performance, identify root causes, resolve conflict, and create accountability across teams and functions.
* Experience working with ERP, CRM, scheduling, and field-service systems.
* Ability to travel frequently throughout the Northeast and remain actively engaged with teams and operating locations.
* Bachelor's degree; equivalent relevant leadership experience will also be considered.

  

**Why People Love Working Here**

* **Build Something Great:** Join a growing company where your work is visible, your ideas matter, and you can make a meaningful impact on what we build next.
* **Our Values:** We're Problem Solvers, Likable, Ambitious, and Caring — values that shape how we work, lead, and support one another.
* **An Award-Winning Workplace:** We're proud to be recognized as a Top Workplace, reflecting the culture, collaboration, and people behind our continued growth.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plan options
* Free virtual healthcare for employees and family members
* Health Savings Account (with HDHP enrollment)
* Health & dependent care flexible spending accounts
* Company-paid basic life insurance
* Voluntary supplemental life insurance
* Company-paid short-term disability insurance
* Voluntary long-term disability
* Company-paid Accident and Hospital Indemnity
* Free Bereavement and Life Planning Support for employees and family members
* 401(k) with company match (Pre-tax & Roth options)
* Paid PTO, bereavement leave, and maternity leave
* 7 company-paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**About Us**

Express Flooring, a leading provider of residential and commercial flooring solutions in multiple states, is seeking highly spirited and dedicated professionals to join our team in various positions. Our mission is to deliver a superior floor covering experience to our customers by offering top-quality products, professional installation, and unparalleled customer service.

As a rapidly expanding company, we are always looking for ambitious individuals who are not just looking for a job, but a rewarding career. We value problem solvers who are passionate about finding innovative solutions to challenges. At Express Flooring, we care deeply about our employees and strive to provide unlimited potential for growth, job security, highly competitive earnings, and comprehensive benefits packages for our full-time employees

Express Flooring is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Express Flooring is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

* Sets appropriate expectations and assesses performance of direct reports, including team leaders.
* Rewards and retains team members based on results and by creating an environment supportive of growth and development.

Reporting into the Enterprise Services (ES) Operations team, this role is ideal for leaders who have built their careers within **Healthcare Systems** and are ready to apply that expertise on a broader strategic scale. ES Operations delivers a portfolio of value‑driven solutions—including performance guarantees and advanced technologies powered by Siemens Healthineers—to help transform healthcare delivery for our partners.

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience through clear communication and proactive relationship building.
* Lead strategic engagement across the customer’s organization, including budgeting, asset management, capital planning, procurement, and KPI alignment.
* Collaborate across business lines to ensure transparency around inputs, outputs, challenges, and risks.
* Respond efficiently to concerns and support problem resolution.
* Contribute to broader Enterprise Services Operations initiatives as needed.

* **Direct leadership experience within a Healthcare System**, such as serving as a manager or director over a clinical or hospital department or service line (e.g., Radiology, Laboratory Services, Cardiovascular, Oncology, Emergency Medicine), or supporting hospital operations, strategy, or business development.
* A deep understanding of the **complex operational, regulatory, research, and educational missions unique to Healthcare Systems**, and how they influence clinical workflows, asset utilization, staffing models, and capital planning.
* Demonstrated ability to assess clinical asset management needs and develop **short- and long-term operational and capital plans**—including technical/clinical performance management, skill development, operational execution excellence, and compliance oversight.
* Strong working knowledge of **health system service line operations**, particularly within environments that manage multi-site academic practices and large-scale procedural departments.
* A results‑driven mindset, with the ability to balance customer impact, clinical quality, and business objectives.
* Strong project management capabilities and ability to prioritize and lead multiple initiatives in fast-paced, high-acuity settings.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage executives, clinical leaders, and frontline teams.

**Required qualifications for success in this role:**

* **BS/BA in a medical field, engineering/technology, healthcare/business administration, or related healthcare discipline.**
* **Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience within a Healthcare System**, whether through direct clinical department management or hospital operations/business development.
* Experience in **clinical administration or healthcare institution leadership**.
* Ability to travel up to 15%.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Polished, professional presence and strong executive communication skills.
* Strong analytical and business acumen, including familiarity with **P&L management, capital & operational planning, and resource stewardship**.
* Ability to assess business situations using a **general manager perspective**, with strengths in structured problem solving and critical thinking.
* Proven success implementing innovative solutions for clinical or operational challenges, with the ability to navigate organizational complexity typical of Healthcare Systems.
* Experience evaluating client commercial capabilities and identifying opportunities for growth, optimization, or process improvement.
* Adaptability to changing client needs, cost initiatives, policy shifts, and evolving healthcare landscapes.
* A naturally curious, continuous‑learning mindset.
* PMP or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work:** When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here.
