**About JDL Access, LLC**

JDL Access, LLC is a boutique company that provides comprehensive reimbursement support services (patient access programs and payer access) to medical technology/device companies. We are seeking a Director of Reimbursement and Client Support to manage client relationships and to be the hands-on reimbursement expert our clients rely on every day. In this role, you will be both the trusted strategic partner and the person who rolls up your sleeves to help clients at the intersection of strategy and tactical support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the dedicated primary liaison for our clients, owning the relationship from on-boarding through ongoing account management and growth planning.
* Provide strategic reimbursement expertise to clients as it relates to the support services.
* Lead client meetings, quarterly business reviews, and executive briefings that reinforce partnership value and shared goals.
* Act as a trusted advisor who understands each client’s business objectives and anticipates their evolving reimbursement needs.
* Develop and execute tailored account plans that deepen engagement, expand service utilization, and drive measurable value.
* Proactively monitor account health, anticipate risks, and resolve escalations to protect and strengthen the relationship.
* Track performance metrics, client feedback, and case-level trends to surface risks, gaps, and growth opportunities with actionable recommendations.
* Champion the voice of the client internally, partnering to build client feedback into service enhancements and program development.*Client Communications & Strategic Reporting*
* Maintain a steady cadence of proactive outreach and strategic check-ins so clients feel informed and supported at every stage.
* Translate case-level and program data into clear, client-ready performance narratives and insights aligned to each client’s priorities.
* Ensure all client-facing reporting, communications, and presentations are accurate, timely, and consistent with agreed-upon metrics and contractual commitments.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration & Internal Partnership*

* Act as the connective tissue between clients and our operations, analytics, and delivery teams, keeping everyone aligned to client expectations and contract obligations.
* Maintain accurate account documentation, including contact records, account plans, meeting notes, and payer intelligence, to ensure continuity.
* Escalate client risks, satisfaction concerns, or service gaps with documented context and clear recommendations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 5+ years of experience in medical device reimbursement and/or patient access services.
* Working knowledge of coding, payment, and coverage for medtech.
* Proven record of managing client relationships and delivering measurable satisfaction and retention outcomes.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, account management tools, and client satisfaction measurement frameworks.

**Associate Director (RCG)**  
  
We are looking for an Associate Director with deep expertise in the Retail & Consumer Goods (RCG) sector to support our continued growth within our Manufacturing, Automotive, Energy, Retail & Consumer Goods (MAE) practice. The Associate Director serves as a trusted advisor to senior executives across the consumer goods ecosystem, leading cross-functional project teams from pre-sales through full end-to-end Salesforce implementations.  
  
Success is measured by account expansion, team leadership, and driving digital transformation for RCG clients. Focus areas include optimizing trade promotion management (TPM), field sales execution, route-to-market strategies, and direct-to-consumer commerce architectures powered by Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary trusted advisor for a portfolio of Retail & Consumer Goods (RCG) clients, establishing strategic executive-level relationships across sales, field operations, marketing, and IT functions.
* Accountable for portfolio performance, including booking targets, revenue realization, margin health, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts by aligning business challenges in trade promotion, store execution, channel distribution, and supply chain visibility with tailored Salesforce solutions.
* Lead executive-level conversations on modernizing retail execution, field sales operations, distributor management, and customer care workflows.
* Lead engagement planning, budgeting, scope definition, and staffing across complex Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud (CGC) and multi-cloud implementations.
* Oversee project kick-offs, sprint planning, solution architecture alignment, and delivery governance to ensure high-quality, on-time client outcomes.
* Match SOW deliverables with delivery team capacity and capability, ensuring optimal margin alignment and project health.
* Manage engagement risk, dependencies, and executive escalations across complex RCG client matrices.
* Continuously refine project delivery methodology for Consumer Goods Cloud to improve speed-to-value and repeat execution.
* Participate in and lead proposal development, RFPs, pitch presentations, and pricing strategies for new and existing accounts in the RCG space.
* Bring deep functional knowledge of retail execution, field rep scheduling, territory management, planogram compliance, order capture, and trade spend management into the pre-sales process.
* Lead, mentor, and build high-performing consultant and technical teams delivering specialized Salesforce RCG solutions.
* Contribute to practice-building assets, RCG reusable accelerators, and thought leadership around Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

**Experience/Skills Required:**

* 10+ years of consulting or digital transformation experience, primarily within the Retail & Consumer Goods (RCG) or CPG sectors (familiarity with broader Manufacturing & Supply Chain ecosystems is a plus).
* Strong domain understanding of CPG go-to-market strategies, retail execution, field sales operations, trade promotion management (TPM/TPO), key account management, and distributor delivery models.
* 5+ years’ experience delivering Salesforce or CRM projects
* Proven relationship and program management skills with experience growing and developing a strong, trusted-advisor relationship with customers
* Project management experience that includes proposals, contract management, pricing, risk management and project staffing
* Demonstrated ability to lead and manage teams through influence while also functioning as an individual contributor
* Participated in Sales and Business Development Efforts
* Hands-on exposure to or leadership of Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud (CGC) implementations (Retail Execution, Trade Promotion Management, Field Rep Analytics).
* Broad familiarity with complementary Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, or Tableau) in an RCG setting.
* Has working knowledge of CRM or Marketing Automation applications, specifically Salesforce
* Extremely detail-oriented
* Ability to handle stress and last-minute, urgent requests
* Must have full-time permanent US work authorization

**Additional Preferred Experience/Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or equivalent experience
* Travel to client sites, as needed
* Why Coastal, and what we offer:
* Flexible working hours with an emphasis on a life-work balance (in that order!)
* Remote flexible work; plus company office locations in Palm Coast, FL; Atlanta, GA; Tysons, VA & Lexington, KY; travel as required to client locations
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (RTO), 401K with Company Match, and Medical, Vision, & Dental coverage
* Competitive quarterly bonus opportunities
* Continuing education and certification reimbursements, specifically within the Salesforce and Snowflake ecosystems; plus occasional in-house competitions with spot bonuses
* A flexible and fun team culture! We value transparency, support, flexibility, growth, teamwork, fun, and so much more
* Frequent team and culture activities, virtual & in-person, including Lunch and Learns, Happy Hours, team-building events
* Monthly All-Hands calls to bring the company together, and an open-door leadership policy with access to mentorship and guidance
* Opportunities for accelerated growth, networking, and career guidance and support
* Trust, transparency and respect across all levels of the company

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

Primary Function of Position:
  
As a key people and team leader within Intuitive, the Field Service Manager is responsible for ensuring
  
Intuitive delivers exceptional, timely service to customers through the coordination of all Service-related
  
activities within their Region. Field Service Managers provide strong management and leadership of
  
field-based direct reports and coordination of their activities with other customer-facing and back-office
  
team members. Their teams consistently deliver exceptional service while achieving results by the most
  
efficient and cost-effective means possible. The Field Service Manager spends time in the field visiting
  
with customers and team members to coach and mentor employees, reinforce strong customer
  
relationships, and identify opportunities to improve the Customer Experience. The individual in this role
  
must demonstrate a high degree of business ownership, exceptional customer service, and strong
  
communication skills.
  
Roles and Responsibilities:
  

* Identify and attract talented employees who raise the bar for the team
* Coach and develop employees to improve their impact and achieve their potential
* Create synergistic, collaborative team environments encouraging trust, respect and cooperation

among team members
  

* Demonstrate ability to consistently deliver results
* Use data and metrics to track progress towards and achievement of desired results, and

continuously evaluate and communicate business health
  

* Communicate team performance to management through metrics
* Monitor the use of resources and proactively recommend adjustments when suboptimal
* Demonstrate strong, consistent knowledge of the day-to-day activities of their team, and how

those activities support the organization’s strategy and goals
  

* Ensure team’s work product is of the highest standards of quality, meeting customer needs and

all regulatory/contractual obligations
  

* Ensure all Service Contract obligations and commitments are met and adhered to, and the value

of Intuitive Service is communicated to and understood by customers

* Provide additional escalation support to resolve key account/customer issues are resolved

expeditiously and effectively
  

* Ensure all documentation is submitted and accurate within customer management, employee

management, and quality management systems.
  

* Work collaboratively with commercial and ecosystem partners, both internal and external, to

ensure customer expectations are achieved
  

* Work with Senior Field Service Leadership team on process improvement projects to maximize

efficiency, productivity, and performance.

### **Qualifications**

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:
  

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred in mechanical, biomedical, electronics engineering, or equivalent
* 5 years hands-on field experience working as a field service representative
* 3 years as a manager in the medical industry or equivalent preferred
* Familiarity of hospital operating room protocols, anatomic terminology and knowledge a plus
* Ability to multi-task and adapt to change without losing focus of priorities
* Strong communication, influence, leadership, conflict management and negotiation skills
* Capable of working effectively in cross-functional project teams
* Must possess strong attention-to-detail, individual initiative, and sense of ownership
* Ability to prioritize and smoothly manage multiple competing deadlines and tasks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly ethical, highly energetic character, with a desire to help customers

2eb4a8bd36dc356e4f61.description:
**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.  
  
**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  
  
**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.  
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

  

**Who You Are**  
You are looking for a role where you can develop and mentor a team of Trial Experience Specialists. Your role involves embodying our culture and values, working closely with managers to support and coach team members, and identifying and implementing strategic improvements. Your management style thrives in a high-performance, high-accountability environment, and you possess strong communication skills and a deep understanding of customer and team engagement, time management, organization, and administrative abilities.

Success in this role requires confidence, energy, positivity, and the ability to motivate others. You are adept at collaboration, time-management, and prioritization. At HighLevel, we expect all our team members to engage on camera for all customer and team interactions.

### **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Provide daily leadership, coaching, and empowering Trial Experience Specialists to enhance their performance and development.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for management level inquiries and customer support escalations.
* Facilitate training sessions with Leads and/or Managers to provide ongoing support to team members to enhance their skills along with new hire training.
* Monitor team and department health, contributing to strategic team development.
* Track and report on individual and team performance metrics, providing feedback for continuous improvement.
* Identify areas for process redesign and recommend changes to enhance service quality.
* Address and resolve advanced customer requests promptly, ensuring detailed and accurate documentation.
* Foster a collaborative work environment and encourage effective teamwork.
* Execute additional tasks and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Experience/Education/Certifications Required:
* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent SaaS Experience is strongly preferred.
* Prior experience in SaaS sales, with a proven ability to manage the full sales cycle. Strong communication and negotiation skills are essential.
* Prior experience leading fast-paced, results driven, customer-facing teams for a SaaS or Product-Led Growth company preferred.
* You are a true people coach at heart, you love mentoring, leading and contributing to the professional development of those around you.
* A strong technical aptitude to help our users succeed with the HighLevel software.
* Strong collaboration, time-management and prioritization skills are critical to the success of this role.

92acc2da82bee9774198.title: Supervisor, Customer Service
92acc2da82bee9774198.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Senior Supervisor, Customer Service, this role is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the healthcare customer service call center and supporting front-line staff. This position ensures service delivery meets Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), related to customer satisfaction, response times and providing quality service. Responsibilities include monitoring call center performance, providing coaching and feedback to Customer Service Representatives (CSRs) and Leads, and aligning team efforts with organizational goals. This position also handles escalated issues, ensuring timely resolution and proper documentation. Additionally, the role contributes to recruiting, onboarding, and training within the department.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Call Center Support*

* Manage and process staff timesheets, payroll, and daily attendance
* Generate and analyze daily call center performance reports
* Monitor real-time service levels to ensure performance goals are met
* Coordinate overtime with Workforce Management as appropriate
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding and termination processes as needed
* Provide guidance, support, and timely feedback to staff
* Assist CSRs with escalated issues
* Meet deadlines and respond promptly to internal and external inquiries
* Implement customer service strategies and coordinate training needs with Workforce Management and Training

* Require direct reports to hold themselves accountable to high performance standards and personal conduct in a clear, helpful, straightforward way
* Conduct one-on-one conversations with every direct report monthly focused on their 3A+ capabilities, impact, and effort
* Make decisions impacting staff using the steps outlined in the “Outward Leadership” guide
* Promote a culture of inclusion leveraging the “Outward Inclusion” principles

*Other*

Do everything possible to help members succeed by being curious and striving to understand what others are trying to achieve, planning, and executing work helpfully and collaboratively. Be willing to adjust efforts to ensure that work and attitude are helpful to others, be self-accountable, create a positive impact, and be diligent in delivering results
* Maintain internet speed of 40 MB download and 10 MB upload and router with wired Ethernet

The physical demands and work environment described here represent those that an employee must meet to successfully perform this job’s essential functions. 6d3d024f682305a88bc4.title: General Manager, Process Safety Testing
6d3d024f682305a88bc4.description:
**In compliance with applicable pay transparency requirements, the application window for this position is expected to close on October 30, 2026, subject to change based on business need.**

**A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:**

The General Manager, Process Safety Testing is the on-site business, people, safety, and technical leader for the Princeton Process Safety Testing Laboratory. This role is responsible for creating and sustaining a strong safety culture, developing leaders and employees, fostering accountability, and building an engaged, high-performing team. The General Manager provides leadership and oversight for the DEKRA Princeton Process Safety Laboratory, with responsibility for P&L performance, safety, equipment reliability, quality, and profitable growth. The role combines engineering and production-minded leadership with laboratory experience and serves as a visible partner to customers, Sales, Marketing, Consulting, and shared services. This position also serves on the Process Safety North America leadership team. The General Manager translates market demand into executable laboratory capacity by improving local processes, increasing asset reliability and utilization, maintaining accreditations and regulatory compliance, and delivering a consistent customer experience across the Process Safety business.

Long-term success in this role requires more than operational and technical leadership. This position is responsible for strengthening the site’s culture, developing people and local leaders, and reinforcing an environment where safety, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement shapes how the organization operates every day.

**About DEKRA's Princeton Process Safety Laboratory**

DEKRA's Princeton Process Safety Laboratory utilizes state-of-the-art equipment to help clients around the world understand and manage the risks associated with industrial dusts, powders, gases, vapors, and reactive chemicals. Serving industries such as pharmaceuticals, food, chemical processing, energy, and advanced materials, the laboratory conducts a wide range of process safety tests that support safer facility design, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. The team work alongside experienced scientists and engineers in a collaborative, hands-on environment, generating critical safety data that helps prevent incidents, protect employees, and improve industrial processes across some of the world's most innovative companies.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Business Leadership and Growth**

* Own the Princeton site P&L, annual operating plan, forecasts, capital priorities, and performance against revenue, margin, and budget commitments.
* Lead the site growth plan by connecting market opportunities, pricing, capacity, staffing, and investment decisions; identify risks early and bring practical solutions to senior leadership.
* Provide on-site leadership for daily laboratory operations in partnership with laboratory managers and technical leads, with clear ownership, priorities, and escalation paths.
* Establish and monitor practical operating metrics, including safety, quality, turnaround time, backlog, sample throughput, capacity, equipment utilization, on-time delivery, and financial performance.
* Drive standard work and continuous improvement across inquiry, test selection, quoting, project setup, scheduling, execution, reporting, invoicing, and collections handoffs.
* As appropriate, implement digital or AI-enabled improvements that reduce rework, shorten cycle time, improve visibility, and create a consistent customer experience.
* Ensure critical equipment has effective preventive maintenance, repair, reliability, calibration, spare-part, and capital replacement plans; coordinate vendors and global technical resources as needed.
* Work with lab managers to match staffing and skills to demand, identify constraints before they affect delivery, and build scalable laboratory capacity without compromising safety or quality.

**Technical, Quality, Safety, and Compliance Leadership**

* Actively contribute to a culture of safety and health by demonstrating accountability, communication, and oversight in the following key areas: Strategic Alignment, Accountability, Performance Monitoring, Reports, Communication & Engagement, Incident Management, and Corrective Actions.
* Serve as a credible technical leader for process safety testing and ensure that testing is performed with purpose, sound technical judgment, and clear connection to customer needs.
* Maintain ISO/IEC 17025 and other applicable accreditations and certifications; ensure the laboratory consistently follows approved quality systems, methods, documentation, and review requirements.
* Champion DEKRA safety programs and values and maintaining a psychologically safe operating culture in a hazardous testing environment.
* Ensure compliance with applicable government regulations, site permits, controlled-material requirements, and internal policies.

**People and Organizational Leadership**

* Maintain a high-performing, collaborative site team with clear roles and responsibilities.
* Coach and develop laboratory managers, technical experts, engineers, technicians, and administrative support; mentor emerging leaders and strengthen succession and technical bench depth.
* Create consistent communication rhythms, including site updates, cross-functional operating reviews, one-on-ones, and issue escalation before problems become significant.
* Lead organizational change with clear, timely communication and operational continuity, including knowledge transfer from experienced leaders and technical experts.
* Promote a One Process Safety culture across Testing, Consulting, Sales, Marketing, and shared services while maintaining clear local accountability for Princeton operations.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry, or a related technical field
* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in process safety testing, laboratory operations, technical services, engineering operations, or a closely related environment, including personnel leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading operations or laboratories with P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and capital-planning responsibility.
* Proven ability to use data and operational metrics to make sound decisions and improve business performance.
* Strong electrical and mechanical knowledge, with demonstrated ability to diagnose equipment failures, identify root causes, and implement practical, effective solutions.
* Practical knowledge of hazardous laboratory operations; experience with combustible dust, chemical reaction hazards, flammability, thermal stability, or related testing is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to improve operational performance using standard work, metrics, Lean or Kaizen methods, capacity planning, and equipment-reliability practices.
* Commercial judgment and experience supporting technical sales, key accounts, proposals, pricing, and business development in a technical-services environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and change-management skills; able to translate strategy into clear priorities and dependable execution.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, IT, and global technical teams.
* Self-directed and comfortable balancing customer needs, technical risk, employee development, operational priorities, and financial performance.

**Physical Considerations:**

* Ability to work in a general office and hazardous laboratory environment and to complete extended periods of computer-based work.
* Ability to work flexible hours as needed, lift 25-50 pounds such as luggage or equipment, move with a full range of motion, and quickly evacuate buildings in an emergency.
* May work around or be exposed to chemicals, chemical fumes, dust, allergens, irritants, controlled substances, pharmaceuticals, loud noise, extreme temperatures, and chemical, electrical, or mechanical hazards.

**Travel Considerations:**

* Domestic travel is required, estimated up to 10%; limited international travel may be required.

**What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:**

**Compensation:**

The base pay for this position ranges from $150,000 annually to $190,000 annually. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location and position-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position is eligible for the DEKRA North America annual bonus plan.

**Benefits:**

DEKRA North America strives to provide a competitive benefits package to colleagues and promotes physical, emotional, and financial well-being. Colleagues can self-select from our benefits to create a package unique to their needs. These benefits include access to competitive health care and retirement benefits, paid time off, mental health well-being resources, and opportunities to learn and develop. Below is a list of benefits we offer our colleagues:

**Health & Well-being Benefits:**

* *Health care benefits: medical & prescription, dental, vision (including Domestic Partners)*
* *Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity supplemental insurance*
* *Company Health Savings Account contribution*
* *Flexible Spending Account for eligible health care and dependent care expenses*
* *Paid time off such as vacation, sick leave, and floating holidays*
* *Mental and emotional support resources through our Employee Assistance Program*
* *Wellness Program to increase activity and health habits, with ability to earn participation rewards*
* *Paid Parental Leave*
* *Travel Assist (Domestic/International)*

**Financial Benefits:**

* *401(k) plan, with an employer match*
* *Company paid Short- & Long-Term Disability benefits*
* *Group term life insurance with options to buy-up for self and others*
* *Working Advantage – DEKRA’s official corporate discount program*

**Growth and Development Benefits:**

* *Education Assistance Program*
* *Student Loan Repayment Assistance*
* *Internal training and development resources to grow your career*
* *LEAD Forward Leadership Development Program*
* *Annual Career Goal Setting and Performance Review cycle participation*

*This list provides an overview of benefits provided for US-based colleagues; the DEKRA North America Employee Benefits Guide outlines plan details and further related eligibility requirements.*

**Additional Position Details:**

* **Reports to:** VP, Process Safety Labs and Consulting
* **Work Model:** On-site with flexible remote work options as operations dictate
* **Work Location:** DEKRA Process Safety - 113 Campus Dr Princeton, NJ 08540,
* **Supervises Others:** Yes, 15-25 individuals, with 3 front line managers
* **Status:** Full-time, Regular
* **FLSA Classification:** Exempt
* **Visa Sponsorship Eligibility:** This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

**About Us:**

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. In DEKRA, you will be part of a continuously growing organization with a 100-year history involved in more than 50 countries on five continents.

We hope you’ll consider a career with DEKRA North America as we strive to become the Global Partner for a Safe World!

*DEKRA North America is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*DEKRA North America is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or accommodation while seeking employment, call +1 (770) 971-3788. We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.*

*DEKRA North America will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay.*

*DEKRA North America participates in the E-Verify program to confirm eligibility to work in the United States.*

**Job Description:** The Material Handler will report to the Operations Manager and/or the Inventory Manager of a Cannabis Cultivation facility to complete the day-to-day operations of incoming and outgoing inventory. Maintaining organized work areas and assisting in order fulfillment. Material Handler is responsible for working with operations team members to organize, process orders and packaging supplies in an efficient and effective manner. The Material Handler role must participate in their job with professionalism and safety, consistently.

This role will also be asked to fill in as needed for the following roles; Delivery Driver and Harvest Trim Associate (HTA).

a9d65ce997e8485a2bef.title: Credit & Collections Account Manager
a9d65ce997e8485a2bef.description:
ASI is the largest global provider of technology B2B services for the $27.7 billion promotional products industry (branding and marketing). With 25,000 clients in 53 countries, our mission is to inspire, inform, and empower our clients' success every step of the way.

ASI currently has a hybrid work model. This position requires in‑person attendance at our office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

The Credit & Collections Account Manager provides credit and collections support across the ASI portfolio of companies. This role is responsible for managing an assigned accounts receivable portfolio within established key performance indicators (KPIs), including delinquency levels, collection activity, payment commitments, and account resolution.

Reporting to the Credit & Collections Assistant Manager, the Credit & Collections Account Manager will be responsible for contacting members regarding past-due accounts, resolving payment issues, negotiating payment arrangements, and maintaining accurate account records. Partners with internal teams to address billing concerns while providing excellent customer service and supporting the timely collection of outstanding balances.

The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $52,000.

**Responsibilities:**

* Maintain an assigned accounts receivable book of business within defined KPIs, including aging, delinquency, collection activity, payment commitments, and account resolution.
* Handle inbound member calls promptly and professionally, research account questions, explain balances and payment options, and document outcomes accurately.
* Make required outbound collection calls to secure payment on delinquent accounts through approved methods, including credit card payments, documented payment promises, and negotiated payment arrangements within established authority.
* Complete assigned daily collection tasks, including follow-up on declined credit cards, accounts approaching cancellation, account locks, broken payment promises, and other priority work items.
* Monitor and work assigned email queues, providing timely, accurate, and professional responses to members and internal departments and escalating matters when appropriate.
* Investigate and resolve member escalations and disputes related to invoicing, billing, payments, credits, or collection activity by coordinating with Sales, Billing, Customer Service, and other internal partners.
* Manage aging reports through consistent and prioritized follow-up, identify high-risk or aging accounts, maintain accurate account notes, and provide regular status updates and recommendations to the Manager.
* Follow company policies and applicable legal requirements for collection practices, ensuring all communications, payment arrangements, account actions, and documentation comply with company standards and local, state, and federal guidelines.
* Perform other related duties and support special projects as assigned by management.

**Requirements:**

* 3-5 years of experience in accounts receivable, account management, credit, or collections is required; business-to-business collections experience is strongly preferred.
* High school diploma or GED equivalent is required; an associate degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of CRM systems, accounts receivable practices, billing procedures, and daily Order-to-Cash (OTC) financial transactions.
* Experience using Microsoft Dynamics CRM or a comparable customer relationship management system is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain account information clearly, professionally, and diplomatically.
* Strong time-management, organizational, and administrative skills, including accurate recordkeeping and proficiency in managing documents, account notes, and spreadsheets.
* Ability to prioritize competing deadlines, manage multiple accounts and work queues, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, problem-solving, and customer service skills, including the ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word; ability to create, maintain, and analyze reports and spreadsheets is preferred.
* Ability to work on-site in the office as required by the position.

ASI offers full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, available on day one of employment.
* Paid maternity and paternity/bonding leave (12 weeks paid for birthing/primary parent and 4 weeks paid for secondary parent) and a parent support group.
* 12 weeks of paid daycare for new parents (14 weeks at our onsite daycare center, Lots of Love).
* Free Health and Wellness programs.
* Free 24/7 access to Magellan Employee Assistance Program and Teladoc.
* Day one 401(k) with company match.
* Paid holidays, floating days, and paid time off (PTO).
* Office amenities with onsite café, Starbucks, 24/7 free gym access and classes, onsite daycare, EV charging stations, creative spaces such as our community garden club, music room, art room, and relaxation space.

Take this opportunity to join our successful team! Apply today! EOE m/f/d/v. ASI is an equal opportunity employer, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or Veteran status. Diversity makes us better. Check out ASI's Diversity and Inclusion Blog Posts.

Visit our company career web site at www.asicareers.com.

Ministry Brands is looking for a **Manager, Support** to join our growing team!

**Who we are**

Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for faith-based, non-profit and for-profit organizations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades. The diverse and real-world experiences of our team members serving their communities makes us stronger together and enhances our ability to advance digital transformation for the greater good.

Ministry Brands is committed to acknowledging and valuing our employee differences and to creating an environment in which every individual’s unique strengths and abilities are developed and valued. Our employees share in the responsibility for creating this environment and demonstrate mutual respect and acceptance in the workplace. We welcome everyone and are dedicated to creating a culture where all our employees have equal opportunity to be heard and reach their full potential.

**What You'll Do:**

The Manager, Support, supervises a staff of client support specialists who provide technical product support to clients and/or end users. You will manage the team’s daily workload to ensure required service volume and quality levels are attained. You will assist with critical customer escalations and train/coach your team in standard policies, procedures, and best practices to provide a high level of service to our clients.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks
* Excellent time management skills
* Experience in Salesforce, Zendesk, and Azure Dev Ops is a plus

**Physical Considerations:**

* Ability to work in a general office environment
* Ability to handle extended periods of computer-based work, including telephone

**Travel Considerations:**

**Benefit offerings designed to promote a life of balance!**

**WE'RE HIRING:** **PARTS LOGISTICS COORDINATOR**

**Location:** Plant 2 | 1440 Ben Franklin Hwy Douglassville, PA 19518 | On-site only (No remote/hybrid work available)

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–4:30 PM | Full-time, First Shift

**Compensation:** Target up to $27.00/hour, based on experience and qualifications

**Build Your Career with ACECO**

Behind every successful repair, replacement, and service operation is someone making sure the right parts are received, accounted for, organized, and shipped where they need to go.

We’re looking for a Parts Logistics Coordinator who takes ownership of that process.

**What This Role Really Is**

This is a combination of shipping, receiving, warehouse coordination, and inventory administration. You’ll manage the movement of parts and materials from the time they arrive until they’re prepared and shipped to their destination.

That means unloading and inspecting deliveries, verifying packing slips, updating inventory records, preparing shipments, coordinating carrier pickups, monitoring orders, and maintaining organized staging areas.

This is not exclusively a desk job, nor is it strictly a warehouse labor position. The right candidate will be comfortable moving between physical warehouse activities and detailed computer-based logistics work throughout the day.

**What You’ll Do**

**Shipping & Order Fulfillment**

* Prepare outgoing parts and material shipments for customer orders and internal needs
* Verify items, quantities, and documentation before shipment
* Package, label, and stage materials for carrier pickup
* Generate shipping documentation and maintain accurate shipment records
* Coordinate pickup schedules with freight carriers and shipping providers
* Provide tracking information and shipment updates as needed
* Identify and communicate issues that could delay shipment or order fulfillment

**Receiving & Material Processing**

* Unload incoming shipments and verify deliveries against packing slips and supporting documentation
* Inspect materials for visible damage, shortages, and discrepancies
* Identify and communicate receiving issues promptly
* Ensure received materials are properly labeled, stored, or prepared for further processing
* Update inventory and receiving records electronically
* Generate receiving reports and process associated paperwork

**Order Coordination & Material Staging**

* Stage parts and materials for upcoming shipments
* Monitor expected delivery dates and communicate changes
* Ensure packaging materials and shipping supplies are available
* Coordinate priorities to support timely order processing
* Follow up on outstanding materials and shipment-related issues
* Maintain an organized and efficient material staging system

**Inventory Control & System Accuracy**

* Maintain accurate inventory records through timely system transactions
* Establish and maintain inventory bin locations as needed
* Process inventory transfers within Jobscope
* Identify discrepancies between physical materials and system records
* Support accurate stock organization and inventory visibility

**Documentation & Administrative Support**

* Scan job files and supporting documentation to maintain electronic records
* Maintain organized shipping, receiving, and order documentation
* Prepare completed paper job files for Parts Manager review
* Use Microsoft Excel and internal systems for tracking and coordination

**Who Thrives Here**

**This role is a strong fit if you:**

* Take ownership of your work without needing constant reminders
* Enjoy organizing materials, tracking shipments, and keeping operations moving
* Pay close attention to quantities, part numbers, paperwork, and inventory records
* Notice discrepancies and take action instead of assuming someone else will catch them
* Can balance multiple shipments, deliveries, and changing priorities
* Are comfortable using computers, inventory systems, and Microsoft Excel
* Communicate clearly when shipments are delayed, damaged, incomplete, or incorrect
* Work well with others but can also manage responsibilities independently

**This role is likely not a fit if you:**

* Prefer exclusively desk-based or exclusively physical work
* Frequently overlook details in documentation or inventory records
* Are uncomfortable learning ERP or inventory management systems
* Avoid communicating problems or following up on incomplete work
* Are looking for a remote or hybrid position

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education**

* High school diploma or GED preferred
* Additional education or training in logistics, supply chain, inventory management, or warehousing is a plus
* Equivalent relevant work experience will be considered

**Experience**

* Previous experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse operations, logistics coordination, or inventory control preferred
* Experience preparing shipments, processing receiving documentation, and coordinating carrier pickups preferred
* Experience with inventory management systems, warehouse management systems, or ERP software strongly valued
* Jobscope experience is a plus but not required
* Experience working with industrial parts, manufacturing materials, or service parts is a plus

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to accurately verify part numbers, quantities, packing slips, and shipping documents
* Basic inventory control and stock-location practices
* Computer proficiency, including data entry and electronic recordkeeping
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
* Ability to learn and navigate ERP and inventory management systems

**Core Attributes**

* Personal accountability and reliability
* Strong organization and time management
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Clear verbal and written communication
* Problem-solving and follow-through
* Safety awareness
* Commitment to quality, continuous improvement, and GRIT

**What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days**

**First 30 Days**

* Learn ACECO’s Parts Department operations, warehouse layout, and shipping and receiving procedures
* Become familiar with Jobscope, inventory records, shipping documentation, and order workflows
* Learn how parts are received, inspected, labeled, stored, staged, and shipped
* Begin completing receiving and shipping activities with training and guidance
* Understand expectations for safety, organization, accuracy, and communication

**Days 31–60**

* Independently complete routine receiving and shipping transactions
* Accurately verify incoming deliveries against documentation
* Prepare outgoing shipments with correct packaging, labeling, and paperwork
* Maintain organized staging areas and monitor expected delivery dates
* Process inventory transactions with minimal corrections
* Communicate shipment discrepancies, delays, and inventory concerns promptly

**Days 61–90**

* Reliably manage assigned daily shipping, receiving, and order coordination responsibilities
* Maintain accurate inventory and shipment records
* Anticipate upcoming shipments and prepare materials accordingly
* Coordinate carrier pickups and communicate tracking information
* Identify opportunities to improve material organization and workflow efficiency
* Demonstrate consistent ownership, accuracy, safety awareness, and follow-through

**Why Join Our Team at American Crane?**

**Your Work Has a Direct Impact**

The parts you receive, organize, and ship support equipment that our customers depend on. Accurate logistics help reduce delays and keep service operations moving.

**A Balance of Hands-On and Computer-Based Work**

This role offers variety throughout the day, combining warehouse activities with order tracking, inventory transactions, shipping documentation, and coordination.

**Ownership of Your Responsibilities**

You’ll be trusted to manage important daily activities, identify problems, and follow through to resolution.

**Learn Specialized Industrial Parts Operations**

You’ll gain exposure to the components, materials, and logistics supporting custom-engineered overhead cranes, hoists, and industrial lifting equipment.

**A Team That Values Reliability**

At ACECO, safety, quality, accountability, and GRIT are expectations that show up in how we work every day.

**What’s In It for You?**

* Competitive compensation targeted at up to $27.00/hour, based on experience and qualifications
* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance available on the first day of employment
* Generous paid time off with annual rollover
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Ten paid company holidays
* Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities
* Consistent first-shift, Monday–Friday schedule
* Hands-on experience in industrial parts and logistics operations
* Opportunity to develop inventory, ERP, and supply chain skills
* A team environment where accuracy, ownership, and follow-through matter

**What to Expect From Our Hiring Process**

Every application is personally reviewed by our internal Talent Acquisition team. We do not rely on automated screening tools.

We encourage applicants to tailor their resume to accurately reflect their experience with shipping, receiving, inventory systems, warehouse operations, material coordination, and documentation.

Qualified candidates typically hear from us within a few business days, depending on application volume.

During the interview process, candidates should be prepared to discuss specific examples involving shipping and receiving accuracy, inventory discrepancies, order coordination, organizational practices, and situations where they identified and resolved problems.

**Ready to Apply?**

We hire people who show up, take ownership, pay attention to the details, and take pride in doing the job right.

If you enjoy keeping materials organized, making sure shipments are accurate, and helping a team deliver on its commitments, we encourage you to apply.

**Submit your application online through our Career Center.**

**Work Location & Schedule**

This position requires full-time, on-site availability Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM. Candidates should live within a reasonable daily commuting distance of ACECO’s Plant 2 location in Douglassville, Pennsylvania.

Remote and hybrid work are not available. If relocation is necessary, the selected candidate must relocate before starting employment. American Crane & Equipment Corporation does not provide relocation assistance.

**Work Environment**

This position is primarily performed in a parts, warehouse, and industrial service environment with regular computer-based administrative responsibilities. The role involves handling incoming and outgoing shipments, organizing and staging materials, inspecting deliveries, and working with warehouse inventory.

The work environment may include industrial noise, moving equipment, material-handling activities, and changing operational priorities. Employees must follow applicable safety requirements and wear designated PPE.

The position requires a combination of standing, walking, handling materials, and computer-based work throughout the day.

**Requirements**

* Authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to verify identity and employment authorization in compliance with Form I-9 requirements
* Eligibility to access information or technology governed by applicable U.S. export-control laws, including 10 C.F.R. Part 810, EAR, and/or ITAR, where applicable
* Willingness to undergo a background check in accordance with applicable laws
* Willingness to undergo a pre-employment drug screen and randomized drug testing during employment
* Ability to work the required on-site schedule and maintain reliable attendance and punctuality
* Ability to safely perform shipping, receiving, inventory, and material-handling activities
* Willingness to follow applicable safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment
* Willingness to complete required safety, equipment, and role-specific training
* Ability to maintain accurate records and protect confidential business and customer information
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation
* Ability to maintain professional conduct aligned with company expectations

**American Crane & Equipment Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

The company maintains and observes employment policies that do not discriminate against any person because of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability, age, ancestry and any other basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. This applies to recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, overtime, job classifications, work assignments, promotions, demotions, layoffs, terminations, transfers, and all other conditions of employment.

**This position requires:**

* Valid proof of identity and authorization to work in the U.S. (Form I-9)
* Eligibility to access information or technology governed by U.S. export control laws, including 10 C.F.R. Part 810. If government authorization is required for access to controlled technology, employment or start date may be delayed or withdrawn in accordance with applicable law

The pay for this position is dependent on circumstances including an applicant's skills and qualifications, certain degrees and certifications, prior job experience, market data, and other relevant factors.

American Crane & Equipment Corporation offers a wide array of comprehensive benefit programs and services including medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts to our benefits-eligible employees. Additional benefits include retirement savings plans like 401(k) and paid time off, paid holidays, and disability coverage. Some benefits offerings are subject to any legal requirements or limitations, employee eligibility status, and where the employee lives and/or works.

Regardless of past practice, all resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at American Crane & Equipment Corporation without a valid written search agreement in place for that position will be deemed the sole property of American Crane & Equipment Corporation, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by American Crane & Equipment Corporation as a result of the referral or through other means.*

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**About the Operations Coordinator Position**
---------------------------------------------

  
  

As an Operations Coordinator, you will help actively manage the flow of work through a fast-paced, high-volume document processing operation that supports government clients with critical receivables processing and the handling of sensitive documents. Working closely with a team of peers, you will leverage detailed process knowledge to keep work moving, identify and resolve problems, support employees, and respond to changing operational needs throughout the shift.

A central part of your role will be workflow management. You'll actively monitor work as it moves through the operation, engage with employees and peers to address developing issues, and make real-time adjustments to priorities and workflow to help prevent delays and maintain production goals. Success in this role requires looking beyond the task directly in front of you and maintaining awareness of what is happening across the broader operation.

This is a physically active, highly interactive role that combines workflow coordination, operational analysis, problem-solving, teamwork, and employee support. Your day will involve consistent motion (standing, walking, and some lifting) as you work to assist people, assign resources, and resolve issues throughout the day. You'll work closely with employees, fellow Operations Coordinators, and leadership while balancing multiple priorities throughout the day. You'll need to understand how staffing, workload, quality, deadlines, and operational processes interact, and recognize how decisions made in one area may affect another.

Because the operation involves detailed, highly manual document processing, exceptions and human errors are a normal part of the environment. You will be expected to understand processes well enough to recognize when something doesn't look right, investigate what occurred, determine the appropriate response, and either resolve the issue or escalate it appropriately. You will also serve as an important resource for employees by answering questions, explaining procedures, helping staff navigate unfamiliar situations, and communicating not only what needs to happen, but, when possible, why.

A typical shift may involve moving between operational areas to assess workflow, responding to employee questions, troubleshooting processing issues, addressing a developing bottleneck, coordinating workload adjustments with peers, communicating issues to leadership, researching an exception, and then returning to previously interrupted responsibilities. Some responsibilities are predictable. The order in which they'll need attention often is not.

This role is best suited for individuals who enjoy understanding how processes work, keeping operations moving efficiently, solving problems, helping others succeed, and working collaboratively within a team environment. If you thrive in a fast-paced setting, can adapt quickly to changing priorities, and are comfortable balancing attention to detail with awareness of the bigger picture, you'll likely find this role both challenging and rewarding.

**Qualifications**

* Availability to work a Friday – Monday (weekend) 2nd shift schedule; includes some holidays
  + Schedule: Sunday, Monday, Friday, Saturday (5:00 PM - 3:30 AM)
* 2+ years experience in an operations, production, logistics, document processing, or other high-volume work environment
* U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Resident status (Green Card holder)
* Ability to successfully complete and maintain eligibility for a comprehensive government background investigation, including periodic renewals.
* Ability to perform the physical requirements of the role, including lifting up to 40 pounds, extensive walking, and frequent bending, reaching, and lifting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced setting
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and make sound decisions using available information
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain processes and procedures to employees with varying levels of experience and knowledge
* Demonstrated ability to build productive working relationships and collaborate effectively within a team environment
* Proficient in basic computer applications, particularly Microsoft Office; ability to learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, accuracy, and procedural compliance

Additional Success Factors

* Previous experience coaching, mentoring, or training employees
* Previous experience in a team lead, workflow, or informal supervisory role
* Previous experience working in a regulated, compliance-focused, or quality-controlled environment

Education

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own assigned POD(s) for the shift, including opening the area, assigning work to operators, and ensuring staff and supplies are in place at the start of each shift.

* Monitor the flow and volume of work across assigned processes throughout the shift, maintaining awareness of workload, staffing, priorities, and potential constraints.

* Anticipate bottlenecks and take action before they significantly affect the operation; reassign resources as needed when work slows or accumulates.

* Balance immediate demands with downstream impact, recognizing how decisions in one part of the process may affect another.

* Manage the Batching, Scanning, and Dispatch processes within assigned POD(s), ensuring each function is appropriately staffed and operating without interruption.

* Monitor productivity and quality across all POD members, providing timely feedback and guidance to address concerns as they arise.

* Ensure priority items — including Fee Issue work, intercepts, rejects, and customer service items — are actioned and completed by end of shift.

* Periodically check specialty and support areas (mailroom, intercept, and assigned functions) to confirm staffing, SOP adherence, and volume is on track.

* Review work and identify errors, inconsistencies, missing information, or unusual situations that do not fit the expected process.

* Investigate issues to understand what occurred, determine the appropriate next step, and resolve routine problems within your scope of responsibility.

* Compare completed work against established procedures, requirements, and controls; escalate situations involving additional risk or operational impact appropriately.

* Identify recurring errors or patterns that may indicate a broader process, knowledge, or workflow issue — looking beyond the immediate problem to understand why it occurred.

* Maintain a strong understanding of MCA Controls, including what is being monitored, how it is monitored, and why it matters; reinforce a strong controls culture within the team.

* Ensure audit-related documents are handled and secured appropriately; adhere to and enforce the Clean Desk Policy.

* Escalate capacity, staffing, system, quality, or process concerns — including technical issues with robots, computers, and printers — before they become larger operational problems.

* Develop detailed working knowledge of assigned operational processes, including procedures, controls, dependencies, common errors, and exceptions.

* Serve as a reliable resource for employees, answering questions and helping them work through unfamiliar or unusual situations with coaching rather than simply providing answers.

* Communicate clearly so employees understand not only what action to take, but how their work fits into the larger process.

* Share knowledge with fellow coordinators and operational partners to strengthen consistency across the team, and continue learning as procedures, systems, and business requirements change.

* Support the review and creation of PCMs and Job Aids; participate and contribute to projects, committees, and functional taskforces.

  
  

**What Success Looks Li****ke**
-------------------------------

You may be especially successful in this role if you:

* Like understanding how processes work from beginning to end.
* Naturally pay attention to what is happening around you, not only the task directly in front of you.
* Enjoy anticipating problems and preventing them rather than waiting to react to them.
* Notice when something seems unusual and want to understand why.
* Enjoy becoming highly knowledgeable about a subject.
* Get satisfaction from explaining complicated things in ways that make sense to other people.
* Can shift between big-picture workflow and small details.
* Enjoy staying busy; work with urgency while maintaining accuracy.
* Enjoy working within a team.
* Are comfortable making decisions with available information and recognize when additional guidance is needed.
* Remain approachable when people interrupt you with questions.
* Can change priorities quickly and then return to unfinished work without losing track of it.
* Recognize that operational success is a team effort and willingly step in to support peers and employees when needed.

a94686d4b916fc47cb6e.title: Sales & Client Experience Coordinator
a94686d4b916fc47cb6e.description:
Sunshine Jewelry Media is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and people-oriented Sales & Client Experience Coordinator to help keep daily operations running smoothly and create memorable experiences for clients.

This role is a mix of sales coordination, client communication, administrative support, and event planning. We are looking for someone who loves organizing, enjoys making things happen behind the scenes, and can anticipate needs before they become problems.

Think of this person as a *personal experience planner for jewelry clients*: someone who makes sure every inquiry, appointment, event, and client interaction feels thoughtful, organized, and seamless.

The ideal candidate is a natural organizer who enjoys event planning, communicating with people, coordinating details, and bringing ideas to life.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales & Client Coordination**

* Enter and maintain accurate client information, sales data, and records.
* Follow up with prospective and existing clients to maintain engagement and support sales opportunities.
* Respond to client emails professionally, warmly, and promptly.
* Coordinate appointments and ensure the sales team receives the necessary details and scheduling information.
* Keep client communications, follow-ups, and appointments organized so opportunities are not missed.

**2. Organization & Administrative Support**

* Keep digital records, schedules, client information, and internal systems organized and up to date.
* Help maintain order across store operations, administrative tasks, and ongoing projects.
* Track outstanding tasks and follow-ups to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Identify what needs attention and proactively take action without waiting for constant direction.

**3. Events Planning & Promotion**

* Assist with planning and coordinating client events, in-store experiences, and special promotions.
* Organize event logistics, timelines, invitations, guest lists, and follow-ups.
* Help execute promotional campaigns and ensure all details are completed on time.
* Bring creative ideas to improve client engagement and create memorable jewelry shopping experiences.
* Coordinate with the sales team to ensure events and promotions translate into meaningful client relationships.

**4. Proactive Operations Support**

* Anticipate business needs and identify ways to make daily operations more efficient.
* Keep track of upcoming deadlines, appointments, events, and priorities.
* Take ownership of tasks from planning through execution.
* Look for opportunities to improve organization, communication, and the overall client experience.

What We’re Looking For

* **Exceptional organizational skills.** This is a must-have. You enjoy creating order, managing details, and keeping multiple priorities on track.
* **Proactive mindset.** You anticipate needs, spot gaps, and take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* **A love for event planning.** You enjoy coordinating details, creating experiences, and making things happen.
* **Strong communication skills.** You are comfortable responding to emails, following up with clients, and coordinating with a sales team.
* **Attention to detail.** You maintain accurate records and ensure appointments, client information, and follow-ups are handled correctly.
* **People-oriented approach.** You enjoy helping clients feel valued and creating positive experiences.
* **Comfort with technology.** You can learn and use digital tools for data entry, scheduling, email, and client management.
* **Dependability and ownership.** You follow through on commitments and take responsibility for completing tasks.

Previous experience in sales coordination, customer service, event planning, hospitality, retail, or administrative operations is a plus.

Work Arrangement

This position will begin part-time for an initial 90-day period. Depending on business needs, performance, and the evolution of the role, there may be an opportunity to transition to full-time.

The role will involve a combination of administrative coordination and occasional in-person responsibilities. The person will not need to be physically present at the store all the time, but must be comfortable coordinating with the team and attending the store when needed.

The Ideal Candidate

You are the person who remembers the details, follows up before anyone has to ask, keeps everything organized, and makes sure plans become reality. You enjoy creating memorable experiences, whether that means coordinating a client appointment, organizing a special event, or ensuring the sales team has everything they need.

You are organized, resourceful, creative, and dependable. You don't just complete tasks; you look ahead, anticipate what is needed, and help the business run better.

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Media, PA 19063

Educators Rising is seeking a motivated and professional Part-time Customer Service Associate to join its membership team. This role will also work with other senior staff on related projects to ensure organizational data is complete, accurate, and up to date.

* Provide information about membership benefits, renewals, and processes.

**Additional Duties:**

* Assist in processing shipments and mailing of membership materials, as needed.
* Support office staff as needed to keep operations running smoothly.
* Other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about the mission of Educators Rising and committed to delivering exceptional service to our members through clear communication and efficient processes. They are highly organized, detail-oriented, adaptable, and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications include:**

* A commitment to the mission and values of Educators Rising.
* Proven ability to provide outstanding customer service and support.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize responsibilities and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment with excellent follow-through.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams; experience with Adobe products and project management platforms is a plus.
* Self-starter who embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and organizational change.

**COMPENSATION:**

Educators Rising is prepared to offer $18-$22 per hour as compensation for the role, depending on experience.
