8c5ba426a55fdccdaff8.title: Fleet Services Coordinator
8c5ba426a55fdccdaff8.description:
When a business relies on its vehicles every day, tire service needs to be convenient, organized, and dependable.

At Switch Mobile Tires, we bring tire services directly to customers. We're looking for a Fleet Services Coordinator who can help manage service requests, organize appointments, and keep communication flowing between fleet customers and our mobile service team.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys coordinating moving parts, solving scheduling problems, and making sure customers receive reliable service.

What you'll handle

* Coordinate mobile tire service appointments for commercial and fleet customers.
* Communicate with fleet managers and business customers about service needs.
* Schedule technicians based on availability, location, and job requirements.
* Track service requests, appointment changes, and job completion updates.
* Help plan efficient service routes and daily schedules.
* Coordinate tire availability and necessary materials before appointments.
* Maintain accurate fleet customer information and service records.
* Follow up with customers regarding upcoming appointments and completed work.
* Assist with service estimates, invoices, and related documentation.
* Respond to scheduling conflicts, urgent requests, and customer questions.
* Work with technicians to resolve service delays and keep customers informed.
* Identify opportunities to improve fleet service coordination and customer satisfaction.

What you'll bring

We're looking for candidates with **2+ years of experience** in fleet services, automotive operations, dispatch, logistics, service coordination, scheduling, or customer support.

Experience in the tire industry or commercial fleet maintenance is preferred but not required.

You should be comfortable managing multiple appointments, communicating professionally with customers, and adjusting schedules when priorities change.

Experience with scheduling systems, spreadsheets, service management software, or fleet management platforms is helpful.

A high school diploma or GED is required. Additional training or education in business, logistics, or automotive services is a plus.

The person who will do well here

You're organized, responsive, and good at keeping track of details.

When a technician's schedule changes or a customer needs an update, you know how to adjust the plan and keep everyone informed.

Most importantly, you understand that reliable coordination helps customers keep their vehicles on the road.

Pacific Cardiovascular Associates Medical Group, Inc. is dedicated to providing exceptional cardiovascular care through a patient-centered approach. Our team is committed to upholding the highest standards of healthcare while ensuring compliance with industry regulations and enhancing patient experiences.

The Authorization Coordinator is responsible for obtaining prior authorizations for medical procedures, diagnostic tests, and treatments to ensure timely access to care for patients at Pacific Cardiovascular Medical Group (PCMG). This role requires a thorough understanding of insurance policies, medical necessity criteria, and payer guidelines. By securing necessary authorizations, the Authorization Coordinator plays a critical role in preventing delays in patient care and minimizing financial risk for both the practice and patients. * Assist in identifying trends in authorization denials and provide feedback to the Revenue Cycle Manager for process improvement.

* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Microsoft Outlook.

**Education and Experience:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in prior authorizations, medical billing, or revenue cycle management.
* Minimum of 3 years of strong customer service experience
* Experience working in a healthcare setting with insurance verification responsibilities preferred.

**A Specialty Path to Good Health**

  

Upperline Health is the nation’s largest provider dedicated to lower extremity, wound and vascular care. Founded in 2017 with the ambitious goal of changing specialty care, Upperline Health delivers a more efficient path for patients to receive consistent and effective treatment for chronic illnesses.

  

**Triage is temporary.**

**Treatment is transformative.**

  

Upperline Health providers coordinate patients’ care among a team of physician specialists, nurse practitioners, care navigators, nutritionists, social workers, and pharmacists for integrated treatment that addresses patients’ immediate and long-term health needs.

  

We put patients at the center of value-based care.

* Work life balance – regular weekday clinic hours

* Supportive interdisciplinary team

Insurance Coordination:

* Obtain necessary pre-authorizations or approvals from insurance companies and coordinate with billing departments as needed.

Team Collaboration:

Experience:

Skills:

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively with diverse patient populations and handle sensitive information confidentially.

  

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Key Competencies:

* Customer-focused with a commitment to ensuring a positive patient experience.

* Detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving abilities.

* Team-oriented and collaborative.

* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.

Join us at PHM as a Client Services Coordinator (CSC) and bring your healthcare expertise to the forefront. You'll play a vital role in assisting clients dealing with a variety of diagnoses, providing essential support and navigating complex healthcare systems. Your problem-solving skills and dedication to customer service will directly impact the lives of our clients, ensuring they receive the best care and outcomes possible. Working closely with clinicians and researchers, you'll be part of a dynamic team environment that combines innovation with compassionate care. This role offers a meaningful opportunity to make a difference in healthcare, where your contributions are valued every day.

* Kick off client engagements. From welcome email to a seamless registration completion, you'll set the tone for each engagement.

* Take ownership of all details related to client meetings, ensuring comprehensive follow-up and completion of action items.

* Concierge level customer service. You combine an unflappable professional presence with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* The highest standards of ethics and personal integrity with a demonstrated capacity for discretion and for handling confidential information with care
* High versatility. You thrive in a multitasking, ever evolving, fast paced role.
* A positive, energetic, client-focused, can-do orientation always bringing innovative ideas, new perspectives, and a wealth of enthusiasm
* Highly technologically adept.
* College graduate strongly preferred (BA or BS)

  

**Learn more with our video,** **A Day in the Life of a CSC on our LinkedIn page!**

***DEXIS*** *is looking for individuals who work their best, help others, and commit to helping us improve our customer lives and celebrate the difference in others.*

*We* *are the leading manufacturer and distributor of innovative dental imaging equipment, software, and solutions. We offer meaningful work through innovation, diverse opportunities, and career progression.*

  

*We also offer*

*Situated on the southern edge of the Lehigh Valley and easily accessible from northern Philadelphia suburbs and the surrounding areas, the Quakertown facility is our North American hub for the design and manufacturing of leading dental imaging devices and software. The facility has a growing, energetic, and diverse mix of professionals spanning engineering, operations, regulatory and quality backgrounds that work collaboratively in the fast-paced medical device field. A friendly and open atmosphere helps to foster strong personal and professional relationships across the organization.*

  
  

The primary function of this position is to ensure the accurate management and maintenance of customer, asset, and service data within SAP and other business systems. This role is responsible for entering and validating customer information, processing customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and warranty entitlements, verifying asset ownership, and ensuring data accuracy throughout the customer lifecycle.

  
  

The Customer Service Representative serves as a key liaison between customers and internal departments by maintaining accurate records, processing transactions, responding to customer inquiries through CRM platforms, email, and phone communications, researching discrepancies, and supporting operational activities. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, data accuracy, organizational skills, and the ability to follow established processes while providing exceptional customer service.

  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide exceptional customer service and timely follow-through to internal and external customers through phone, email, CRM systems, and other communication channels.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, dealers, and internal departments by coordinating information, responding to inquiries, and facilitating issue resolution.
* Process customer SLA requests by validating warranty coverage, service entitlements, contract terms, and supporting documentation while ensuring compliance with established procedures.
* Research and resolve customer inquiries related to warranties, service contracts, asset ownership, equipment history, account information, and service eligibility.
* Utilize SAP, CRM, and other business systems to accurately enter, maintain, and update customer, asset, and equipment information while ensuring data integrity across systems.
* Effectively manage workload and prioritize tasks to meet customer expectations, service level commitments, and organizational objectives.
* Collaborate with internal departments to resolve customer issues, maintain accurate records, and support efficient business operations.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement that enhance customer satisfaction, improve data accuracy, and streamline operational workflows; partner with leadership to implement approved solutions.
* Record customer product quality complaints in accordance with complaint handling guidelines and standard operating procedures, ensuring appropriate escalation to Quality for further review and processing.
* Consistently follow documented procedures, work instructions, and company policies to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Up to 5% travel.

**Job requirements**

**Qualifications**

  
  

* The ideal candidate will possess strong attention to detail, a commitment to data accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* This position requires excellent analytical, organizational, and customer service skills, along with the ability to navigate multiple business systems while ensuring compliance with established procedures and service commitments.
* Candidates must demonstrate a high degree of accuracy when entering and maintaining customer, asset, warranty, and SLA information. The ability to work independently, collaborate effectively across departments.
  

**Ability to work standard departmental hours of 40 hours per week, including holidays and overtime as business needs require.**

  

**Minimum requirements**

* HS Diploma or equivalent
* 1-3 years’ experience in a customer service-related field
  

  

**Preferred requirements**

* + Associates degree
  + 2+ years of contact center experience
  + Experience with Customer Relationship Management Systems (CRM)Experience utilizing SAP

**Expectations:**

* Customer Focus & Professional Communication – Dedicated to meeting the expectations of internal and external customers through exceptional service.
* Communicates effectively in both written and verbal forms while maintaining a professional, respectful, and customer-focused approach.
* Attention to Detail & Accuracy – Demonstrates a high level of accuracy when entering, validating, and maintaining customer, asset, warranty, and SLA information. Consistently ensures data integrity and compliance with established procedures.
* Cooperative – doing or willing to do what is asked or required
* Teamwork & Collaboration – Works effectively with peers, leadership, and cross-functional teams to achieve shared objectives. Demonstrates cooperation, respect, and a willingness to support team success.
* Results orientation – must deliver results
* Problem Solving & Decision Quality – Uses sound judgment, analysis, and experience to identify root causes, resolve issues, and make effective decisions. Responds quickly and accurately to customer concerns, data discrepancies, and operational challenges.

91b9d44999e23cdc1b55.description:
**University Overview**

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Faculty Affairs Coordinator

**Job Profile Title**

Coordinator, Program

**Job Description Summary**

Partners and supports the Division Faculty Affairs Manager with university activities for 180+ faculty members of the Cardiovascular Division, including search & recruitments, appointments, reappointments, promotions, credentialing and affirmative action at Penn, PAH, PPMC, satellite locations, and for Penn Medicine Clinicians. Maintains applicant files and assists search committee by corresponding directly with the candidates, coordinates schedules, interviews, travel and accommodations for recruitments. Gathers and submits and tracks progress for credentialing applications and appointment documents for new faculty and new APPs. Interfaces between faculty affairs and clinical practice managers to complete orientation and on-boarding process for new faculty. Maintains calendar of Chief Administrative Officer. The successful candidate must pay attention to detail, be well-organized, communicative, accountable, manage multiple projects with simultaneous deadlines, as well as work collaboratively and maintain confidentiality with team members and management. This position has the potential for hybrid work after a successful probationary period and supervisory review.

**Job Description**

**This position is contingent upon favorable funding.**

**Job Responsibilities**

* Assists faculty affairs manager with appointments, reappointment and promotion activities as assigned by FA Mgr for all cardiovascular medicine faculty, research, adjunct, clinical and academic support staff including Presbyterian and Pennsylvania Hospital. Submits complete and accurate dossiers for faculty appointments, reappointments, and promotions to the Office of Academic Affairs in a timely manner. Manages and Submits and Follows to completion, all credentialing applications for faculty, APPs, initial med staff appointments and malpractice changes including medical staff reappointments. Manages location privileges for credentialing Ensures accurate and complete entry of faculty CVs into FEDS. Work with Associate Chief of Clinical Affairs related to credentialing reviews and issues. Maintains up-to-date and accurate records of all faculty appointment and hospital credentialing activities. Collaborates, communicates, and cooperates with the University Office of Academic Affairs, the UPHS Medical Affairs Office, and division administrator to ensure accuracy of data and submissions of requests.
* Collaborates and assists FA Mgr with division faculty recruitment; ensures that search and recruitment process is in compliance with PSOM and University AA/EEO guidelines. Preserves and shares documentation for all searches. Assists and collaborates with FA Mgr in managing all steps of faculty recruitment and onboarding. Recruitment responsibilities include: scheduling candidate interview dates, and coordinating travel and hotel arrangements, preparing candidate interview itinerary, hosting candidate on-site, uploading documentation following the interviews. New faculty orientation and onboarding responsibilities includes orientation schedule (with Program mgr), binder and mini-orientation sessions with new faculty, credentialing verification, orientation email with university links.
* Maintains division website, ensuring new faculty profiles are added in a timely manner, and current faculty profiles are updated annually to reflect current professional activities. Updates the “news and announcements” section of the website on a routine schedule and in coordination with the fellowship office news and announcements media activities.
* Maintains calendar for Director of Division Administration, including coordinating meetings and ensuring schedule is up to date.
* Work with the Office of International Programs (ISSS) for faculty and visiting scholars on employment based immigration visa, along with submitting and processing applications and checks for Visa processing.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Arts and 2 to 3 years of experience or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.

**Job Location - City, State**

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

**Department / School**

Perelman School of Medicine

**Pay Range**

$24.21 - $34.00 Hourly Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin (including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

**Special Requirements**  
Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

**University Benefits**

* **Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.
* **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.
* **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.
* **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.
* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.
* **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.
* **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.
* **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.
* **Discounts and Special Services**: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.
* **Flexible Work Hours:** Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.
* **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.
* **Adoption Assistance:** Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

*To learn more, please visit:* *https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay*

848efbd5de4cbd0fd62e.title: HR Generalist
848efbd5de4cbd0fd62e.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Employee Service Center (ESC) delivers fast, accurate and scalable HR support to a distributed workforce. It owns HR transactions, data integrity and compliance, and partners with People Product and HR COEs on digital solutions. We’re growing our HR Generalist team to own work that is too complex for core ESC support but doesn’t require full HRBP ownership. This work often involves nuanced judgment, manager coaching, data processing and interpretation, and cross-functional coordination across the People Org to support cyclical processes such as performance management, annual review, and recruiting. This role offers broad exposure across HR and is a strong path toward HR Business Partnering.

**About the role**
------------------

The HR Generalist serves an important role for the organization as a link between ESC operations and HR Business Partners (HRBPs). You’ll take in, sort and resolve routine but nuanced HR work: manager coaching, performance management, annual review, and project support across multiple areas.

  

You will get to:

* Serve as a frontline point of contact for managers, coaching them through nuanced HR questions with guidance based on policy, practice and risk.
* Run detailed inquiries with employees and ask the right follow-up questions to gather the facts, timeline, and route it to the right team to support.
* Partner with HRBPs to execute people and talent strategies, including performance, annual review, and position management efforts, ensuring operational details are managed end-to-end.
* Participate in HRBP team meetings, talent forums, and relevant syncs to stay current on business context and bring insights back into ESC operations.

* Coordinate with partners to ensure end-to-end case completeness and smooth employee and manager experience across teams.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $86,200.00 - $137,800.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $81,900.00 - $130,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Comfortable in the gray space - you enjoy working through situations with multiple stakeholders and turning ambiguous requests into clear next steps.
* Energized by coaching managers in a way that balances employee experience, fairness and risk.
* Organized and focused on execution. You juggle many requests and close the loop with clean documentation.
* Systems, data, and AI-savvy. You’re excited to use AI tools to work faster, spot patterns and find better ways to support managers and employees.
* A trusted collaborator across teammates who is comfortable working both through tickets and through real-time collaboration (instant messages and live calls).
* Enjoy creating or iterating on SOPs, playbooks, and triage rules based on case pattern analysis and partner feedback.
Highly discrete and reliable when working with sensitive or confidential information related to performance, employee relations, or organizational changes.  

  

Qualifications

* 2+ years HR experience in shared services, employee service centers, employee relations, HR operations, or HR generalist roles
* Experience conducting employee or manager inquires and documenting them clearly and objectively
* Sound judgment in triaging, routing and escalating work based on complexity, risk and business context
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear guidance
Proficiency with Workday (or similar HRIS) and ServiceNow (or similar tools)  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in an HR shared services / tiered support model or similar model where routing, SLAs, and escalation accuracy are core to success.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) to improve workflows, documentation or analysis
* Experience supporting organizational change, re-leveling, or job profile work as a project contributor (project management, documentation, stakeholder prep) alongside HRBPs and CO Es

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

f0747b9729ecd78208fd.title: CX Team Operations Specialist
f0747b9729ecd78208fd.description:
At **Havenly Brands**, we're building this generation's premier destination for all things home. Alongside our award winning Havenly design services, we proudly own and operate some of the best home furnishings brands in the business including Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, Burrow, Inside, and St. Frank. Our family of brands is growing and we're looking for amazing people to join us on this journey!

Havenly is not just the #1 residential interior design service in America - we're architecting the future of how millions design their homes. With our proprietary 3D visualization technology, our worldwide network of designers empowered with AI tools, and our revolutionary customer-facing AI design assistant, we're at the inflection point of a massive market transformation. This isn't just another operations role, it's the opportunity to build the category-defining business at the intersection of AI, design, and commerce.  
  
**Our Core Values**

* **Exhibit Gumption:** meet every challenge with spirit and energy; believe the impossible is possible.
* **Overperform:** work hard, move fast, be scrappy.
* **Stay Playful:** no jerks, no whiners; have fun and keep perspective.
* **Act Like an Owner:** be accountable, speak up, act in Havenly's best interest.

### **About the Role**

As our CX Team Operations Specialist, you'll own the day for one of our brand CX teams: queue health, work rebalancing, daily huddles, the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve, and coverage when the Team Lead, Customer Experience (your manager) is out. This is an operations role, not a people-management role: no direct reports, coaching, check-ins, performance management, hiring decisions, staffing plans or team KPI ownership, which all stay with the Team Lead. The person we're looking for is a steady, organized, solutions-oriented go-to who keeps queues healthy, makes sound policy-aligned calls on tough cases, and stays close to customers by handling contacts 40 to 50% of the time.

**What You'll Own**

* Monitor queues, channels and backlogs throughout the day, flagging volume spikes, aging tickets and SLA risk.
* Rebalance work across the team as directed by the Team Lead.
* Run daily huddles and share updates, policy changes and known issues.
* Provide coverage and continuity for day-to-day operations when the Team Lead is out of office.
* Share a short end-of-day read on queue health and open issues with the Team Lead.
* Take the escalations Senior Agents can't resolve and own them through to resolution.
* Make sound, policy-aligned decisions on exceptions using the same refund, credit and exception approval authority as the Team Lead, and know when to escalate further.
* Partner with the Team Lead on the most sensitive escalations, bringing clear case summaries and recommended solutions.
* Act as the go-to resource during the day for questions on policies, procedures and systems.
* Guide agents through tricky cases in the moment, and share observations on agent strengths and gaps with the Team Lead, who owns coaching.
* Support onboarding as a buddy for new team members.
* Coordinate with internal partners, especially Logistics and Order Operations, to resolve day-to-day issues on individual orders and cases.
* Spend 40 to 50% of your time handling customer contacts via email, chat, SMS and phone, delivering clear, timely and empathetic communication focused on first-contact resolution, in each brand's unique voice.

**What You'll Drive**

* Identify recurring escalation themes and share them with the Team Lead to inform training and process updates.
* Reinforce established processes and quality standards, and keep team reference materials current in partnership with Systems and Tools.
* Gather frontline feedback on technical, product and marketing program issues and pass it to the Team Lead.

### **We Are Looking for People Who**

* Have **2+ years** of hands-on experience in Customer Experience, Customer Support or a related role (ideally in e-commerce or home goods), including handling escalations and complex customer issues with empathy and sound judgment.
* Bring experience as a subject matter expert, team buddy or acting lead supporting peers day to day, plus hands-on experience with modern CX tools (e.g., Kustomer, Gladly, NetSuite), including macros and knowledge bases.
* Bring a basic understanding of how fulfillment and logistics operations affect the customer experience, strong problem-solving skills, the ability to stay calm and organized in a fast-paced environment, and excellent written and verbal communication.
* Approach ambiguous problems by figuring out what's broken and acting on it, not waiting to be told what's next.
* Move fast, take real ownership of outcomes, and hold themselves to a high bar.
* Collaborate well across teams, with a low-ego, no-drama approach to getting things done.

Bonus points if you also have experience with **monitoring queues or real-time operations in a contact center**.  
  
At Havenly, we're building with AI as part of how we work. We're looking for people who are genuinely curious about AI-assisted tools and eager to adopt them; this is about openness, not existing expertise.

### **The Details**

* **Employment type:** Full-time, hourly, non-exempt contract position. *This contract does not convert to a Havenly employee role.*
* **Location:** Remote in USA or Philippines
* **Compensation:** $26 to $28.50/hr USD or $8.75 - $10/hr PHP
* **Benefits:** As a contract position, this role is not eligible for Havenly benefits.
* **Application deadline:** October 30, 2026, unless further applications are needed.

**Interview Process**

We try to follow the below interview process but sometimes find that you or we want to have further conversations. The below process is ideal state, but this can change!

* **Hiring Manager Interview:** with Teague Fuller - Team Lead, Customer Experience. A chat to learn about your experience, what you're looking for next, as well as a chance to ask any questions. (30 min.)
* **Leadership Interviews:** with Billy Lanahan - Sr. Manager, Customer Experience and Lisa Johnson - Director, Customer Experience. A deep dive into the specifics of the role. (30-45 minutes each)

**Role Overview**

* **Title:** Supply & Logistics Operations Coordinator
* **Location:** Remote (US – Tri-State / Eastern Time Zone)
* **Reporting To:** VP of Business Development & VP of Supply Chain Logistics
* **IMPORTANT APPLICATION REQUIREMENT:** *While this position is 100% remote, it directly supports on-site luxury removals across the Northeast corridor. Candidates* ***MUST*** *reside in the NY, NJ, PA, CT, or MA region and possess firsthand familiarity with metropolitan building logistics, Northeast geography, and local contractor workflows. Applications outside of these states will not be reviewed.*

**About Aurora Circ**

Aurora Circ is the nation’s only dedicated secondary marketplace for pre-owned and showroom display kitchens and luxury appliances. We are proud to partner with the world’s premier luxury brands, including eggersmann, SieMatic, Miele, Sub-Zero, Wolf, La Cornue, and Poggenpohl, and take immense pride in being the pioneers who created the industry’s first “Certified” kitchen and appliance standard and resale market.

We are a cutting-edge platform with massive growth ahead of us, driven by a passionate, talented, and innovative team. As we expand, we are looking for that same caliber of extraordinary talent to join us in key roles and help shape the future of our industry.

**The Role**

We are seeking a sharp, highly organized, and unflappable Supply & Logistics Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational bridge between our Business Development acquisition engine and our Logistics/Removal teams.

Sitting directly between our VP of Business Development, our overseas BD Outreach team, and our VP of Supply Chain Logistics, you will take ownership of turning incoming kitchen donation and consignment deals into seamlessly executed removals. This role requires quick thinking, calm client-facing professionalism under pressure, and a sharp understanding of site logistics, contracts, and scheduling.

**Your Core Missions**

* **Contract & Inventory Governance:** Generate, issue, and track acquisition contracts. Update and reconcile detailed inventory lists following on-site inspections.
* **Site Removal & Contractor Coordination:** Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, contractors, and showroom managers prior to removal day. Confirm utility disconnects, verify loading dock access/truck clearance, order Certificates of Insurance (COIs), ensure freight elevator holds, and resolve last-minute site access roadblocks.
* **Logistics & Routing Sanity:** Work closely with the VP of Supply Chain Logistics to assist with scheduling multi-state removal itineraries to ensure transit times and removal schedules are realistic and executable.
* **Client & Financial Communication:** Answer client inquiries regarding consignment payables, donation workflow, and appraisal documentation. Know when to resolve issues independently and when to escalate complex questions to the BD team.
* **Cross-Departmental Alignment:** Maintain continuous sync across BD, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Warehouse Logistics to ensure accurate project handoffs from deal close to warehouse intake.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* **3+ Years of High-Touch Operations, Logistics, or Project Coordination Experience:** Background in interior design project management, residential construction coordination, white-glove trade show/event logistics, specialty freight dispatch, or luxury showroom operations.
* **Unflappable Problem-Solver:** Exceptional poise, quick judgment, and diplomatic phone presence when handling last-minute schedule changes, site delays, or conflicting priorities.
* **Regional & Site Logistics IQ:** Direct familiarity with Tri-State geography, commercial trucking limitations, building access rules (COIs/elevators), and basic contractor workflows (plumbing/electrical disconnects).
* **Executive & Trade Partner Communication:** Professional, high-end communication style capable of handling financial inquiries and logistics details with homeowners, designers, architects, and showroom executives.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Hourly Rate:** $26.00 – $32.00 / hour ($54,080 – $66,560/yr equivalent | Full-Time, 40 hrs/week)
* **Benefits:** Comprehensive healthcare suite including employer-subsidized Health insurance, plus access to Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) retirement plan with company match; generous PTO package and paid company holidays.

01e951ae7f3d6e473ad9.description:
Payroll Coordinator (Part-Time / Remote)

**Company:** Regal Transportation Group  
**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Part-Time (W-2)  
**Compensation:** $22.00 per hour  
**Schedule:** Approximately 6–10 hours per week  
**Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote

About Regal Transportation Group

Regal Transportation Group is seeking a dependable, highly organized, and detail-oriented **Payroll Coordinator** to oversee employee and contractor onboarding, payroll administration, and human resources communications.

This individual will serve as the company's primary point of contact for employee HR concerns, payroll questions, compensation discrepancies, and onboarding assistance.

The ideal candidate will have experience in payroll administration and human resources, demonstrate strong communication skills, and be comfortable independently managing routine HR and payroll responsibilities.

This position requires a high level of accuracy, confidentiality, accountability, and the ability to communicate professionally with employees and management.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee and coordinate the onboarding process for all new employees and independent contractors.
* Ensure employees and contractors complete all required onboarding documents, agreements, and payment information before beginning their assignments.
* Manage employee onboarding through the company's payroll and payment processing software.
* Verify that employees are correctly established within the payroll system, including applicable employment documentation, tax forms, and payment information.
* Coordinate independent contractor onboarding, including required contractor agreements, tax documentation, and payment setup.
* Confirm that all required onboarding documentation has been submitted, verified, and properly maintained.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential employee and contractor records.
* Coordinate employee and contractor offboarding, including appropriate documentation and payment-related procedures.
* Communicate onboarding progress, missing information, and outstanding requirements to management.
* Ensure onboarding procedures are completed accurately and in accordance with established company policies.

2. Payroll Administration & Verification

* Review and verify employee hours through Regal Transportation Group's internal administrative dashboards.
* Monitor employee timekeeping records to ensure hours are accurately documented.
* Review recorded working hours, pay rates, and applicable compensation adjustments for accuracy.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for employee payroll questions and discrepancies.
* Investigate reported payroll discrepancies by reviewing timesheets, schedules, and available company records.
* Make authorized corrections to employee timekeeping records when necessary.
* Document payroll adjustments and maintain accurate records of all corrections.
* Ensure payroll information is accurate and complete before each scheduled payroll cycle.
* Verify that employee compensation is calculated correctly, including applicable overtime, adjustments, and other authorized compensation.
* Assist with contractor payment verification based on applicable agreements and payment records.
* Coordinate payroll preparation and processing through QuickBooks Payroll or other company-designated payment software.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies before payroll is submitted for management approval.
* Communicate outstanding payroll concerns to management when additional authorization is required.
* Maintain accurate and confidential payroll documentation.

3. Human Resources & Employee Relations

* Serve as the **single designated point of contact for employees regarding routine human resources matters**.
* Respond to employee questions, concerns, and requests relating to employment policies, compensation, payroll, and HR procedures.
* Receive, document, and coordinate the resolution of employee HR concerns.
* Maintain professional, timely, and confidential communication with employees.
* Assist employees with questions regarding onboarding documentation, employment records, and payroll information.
* Escalate sensitive employee relations matters, legal concerns, or issues requiring management decisions to company leadership.
* Support management with employee documentation, policy acknowledgments, and administrative HR procedures.
* Ensure employee questions and concerns receive appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Assist with the implementation of employee benefits and additional HR programs as the company expands.
* Maintain organized records of employee communications, HR requests, and resolutions.

4. Payroll Cycle Management

The **Payroll Coordinator** will be responsible for reviewing and verifying payroll accuracy during every scheduled payment cycle.

Responsibilities include:

* Reviewing employee hours and compensation records before payroll is processed.
* Identifying missing hours, incorrect entries, and discrepancies requiring correction.
* Communicating directly with employees to verify disputed or missing hours.
* Confirming that authorized payroll corrections have been completed.
* Reviewing payroll calculations for accuracy and completeness.
* Verifying that employees are assigned the correct pay rates and compensation structures.
* Preparing payroll information for final management authorization.
* Maintaining payroll records and documenting adjustments.
* Ensuring payroll-related responsibilities are completed by established deadlines.
* Coordinating with management to resolve outstanding payroll discrepancies before processing deadlines.

The Payroll Coordinator must be capable of independently organizing and completing payroll verification tasks while maintaining effective communication with employees and management.

**Accuracy and timely completion of payroll verification are essential responsibilities of this position.**

Required Qualifications

* Previous experience in payroll administration, human resources, accounting, or employee timekeeping.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Experience working with payroll software or employee management systems.
* Ability to independently review payroll records and identify discrepancies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to professionally manage employee concerns and confidential information.
* Experience coordinating employee onboarding and maintaining personnel records.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or comparable spreadsheet software.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.
* Dependability and the ability to consistently meet established payroll deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Payroll.
* At least 1–2 years of payroll or HR administrative experience.
* Experience onboarding W-2 employees and 1099 independent contractors.
* Familiarity with federal and Tennessee employment and payroll requirements.
* Previous experience serving as an employee HR or payroll contact.
* Experience supporting small businesses or growing organizations.
* Familiarity with employee timekeeping systems and compensation verification procedures.

Schedule & Compensation

**Compensation:** $22.00 per hour

**Schedule:** Approximately 8–10 hours per week.

**Work Arrangement:** 100% Remote.

This position offers flexible scheduling; however, availability must be coordinated with established payroll processing deadlines, employee onboarding requirements, and employee support responsibilities.

The Payroll Coordinator will be expected to maintain professional and timely communication with employees during designated working hours.

Weekly responsibilities must be completed within the assigned schedule, with any additional hours requiring prior management approval.

Additional hours and expanded responsibilities may become available as Regal Transportation Group continues to grow.

Ideal Candidate

We are seeking an individual who is professional, organized, dependable, and comfortable taking ownership of routine payroll and human resources administration.

The ideal candidate will be capable of ensuring employees and contractors are onboarded correctly, employee concerns are appropriately addressed, and payroll records are accurate before every payment cycle.

This individual should be comfortable serving as the primary contact for employees regarding payroll and HR inquiries while independently investigating discrepancies and maintaining accurate documentation.

The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to manage multiple administrative responsibilities, communicate effectively, maintain confidentiality, and identify potential issues before they become larger operational problems.

**Accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism, communication, and accountability are essential to this position.**

How to Apply

Interested applicants should submit a resume through Indeed detailing their relevant payroll, human resources, employee onboarding, or administrative experience.

Applicants with experience using QuickBooks Payroll, coordinating employee onboarding, and independently managing employee payroll verification will receive preferred consideration.

**Regal Transportation Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 5.0 – 10.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

**Senior Publisher Development & Affiliate Manager**  
  
**AIM | Premium Lead Exchange |** **321aim.com**

**Location:** Remote, U.S. preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About AIM**

AIM is a lead exchange connecting publishers with buyers across Insurance, Home Services, Legal, and Consumer Relief. Publishers use AIM to monetize exclusive form-fill leads, inbound calls, warm transfers, and scheduled appointments.

Our platform combines real-time bidding, ping/post technology, and transparent reporting to help publishers monetize their traffic and buyers connect with qualified prospects.

We’re looking for an experienced publisher development professional who has established industry relationships and knows how to turn those relationships into active, profitable partnerships.

**The Opportunity**

You will own publisher acquisition, onboarding, relationship management, and supply growth.

Your primary focus will be finding and activating high-quality publishers, helping them succeed on AIM, and growing the qualified lead and call volume they deliver. You should be comfortable opening doors, negotiating terms, coordinating launches, and managing performance after a publisher goes live.

**An established network of lead and call publishers is essential for this role.** We want someone who understands how publishers evaluate a monetization partner and can confidently explain why AIM deserves their business.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Recruit publishers:** Build relationships with direct lead generators, paid search and social media buyers, SEO and content publishers, and call center operators.
* **Activate your network:** Use your existing relationships to build a qualified pipeline and accelerate publisher launches.
* **Own onboarding:** Guide partners from initial conversation through commercial terms, integration, testing, and live delivery.
* **Grow supply:** Identify opportunities for additional volume, new verticals, and qualified overflow traffic.
* **Negotiate profitable partnerships:** Establish pricing, payout structures, volume expectations, and payment terms that work for both AIM and its publishers.
* **Match supply to demand:** Work with buyer account managers to prioritize publisher recruitment around active campaign needs, geography, operating hours, and capacity.
* **Improve performance:** Monitor acceptance rates, billable volume, conversion performance, disputes, publisher earnings, and gross profit.
* **Protect quality:** Coordinate with operations and compliance teams to review traffic sources and resolve quality or delivery concerns.
* **Manage relationships:** Maintain consistent communication, run performance reviews, and help publishers identify opportunities to grow.
* **Build a repeatable process:** Maintain accurate pipeline records, launch forecasts, and a scalable publisher acquisition strategy.
* **Represent AIM:** Attend relevant industry conferences and networking events as needed.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in publisher development, affiliate management, pay-per-call, or lead generation partnerships.
* Established relationships with publishers actively generating leads or calls in one or more of these verticals: Insurance, Home Services, Legal, or Consumer Relief.
* A track record of personally recruiting, launching, and growing revenue-producing publisher accounts.
* Hands-on knowledge of ping/post, real-time bidding, lead distribution, inbound calls, and live transfers.
* Strong understanding of CPL, pay-per-call, CPA, and revenue-share economics, including how qualification criteria affect payouts and profitability.
* Experience evaluating traffic sources, lead quality, and publisher performance.
* Familiarity with consent documentation, traffic verification, and publisher compliance review processes.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and analytical skills.
* The ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with technical, operations, and account management teams.

  

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with lead exchanges, affiliate networks, or publisher marketplaces, along with platforms such as Ringba, Invoca, TrackDrive, LeadsPedia, Twilio, or HighLevel.

Familiarity with TrustedForm, Jornaya, API integrations, and call tracking is also valuable.

**What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days**

* Build a prioritized publisher pipeline aligned with AIM’s buyer demand.
* Recruit, onboard, and activate new publishers.
* Generate measurable growth in qualified, billable leads and calls.
* Establish a regular performance review process for active partners.
* Develop a clear plan for expanding publisher volume while maintaining quality and profitability.

  

We will establish specific launch, volume, and growth targets together based on campaign demand and onboarding capacity.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary.
* Uncapped performance bonus and publisher growth incentives.
* Paid time off.
* Health benefits.
* Remote work environment.
* Opportunity to take on broader leadership responsibilities as AIM grows.

  

**Why Join AIM?**

You’ll have direct ownership of a core part of the business: the publisher partnerships that power our exchange.

This is an opportunity to use the relationships and experience you’ve built to shape publisher strategy, influence platform improvements, and see the direct impact of your work on company growth.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Revenue Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll own work the whole go-to-market organization relies on: the policies and processes that govern how we sell and book deals, our global forecasting process, and the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) operating cadence. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations, and work closely with sales leadership, other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and Data.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring experience running a forecast process day to day and a practical understanding of how a sales organization works. You'll work independently to take a problem from "something looks off in the numbers" to a fix that sticks.

GitLab is all-remote, and most of our work happens in writing. Clear, concise documentation is a big part of this job.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the policies that define how deals are booked, credited, and forecasted, including bookings rules, opportunity netting, and sales stages and exit criteria. Write them, get them approved, and make sure the field understands what changed and why.
* Identify process problems before they affect the numbers. Validate and size the problem with data, find the root cause, and drive the fix with the right team, whether that's Revenue Systems, Deal Desk, Enablement, or compensation.
* Partner with Revenue Systems to build policy into system rules, validations, and alerts, reducing manual reviews and after-the-fact corrections.
* Improve forecast methodology by tracking actual results against the forecast, explaining variances, and changing processes that aren't working. Partner with Finance and Revenue Analytics to reconcile the field forecast with the finance outlook.

**Reimagine What’s Possible**

Air Products is seeking a full-time Maintenance Support Representative for our Equipment Support Team. If you take pleasure in addressing technical challenges, helping customers, and operating in a high-energy setting, this opportunity is ideal.

This position supports plant and field maintenance operations in an industrial manufacturing environment. This is **not an Information Technology (IT) role** and does not involve software development, network administration, cybersecurity, or technical support for computer systems.

As a Maintenance Support Representative within the Equipment Support Team (EST), you will provide crucial technical assistance to customers, delivery drivers, Sales, Engineering, and various internal teams across North America.

In this position, you will deliver technical assistance and problem-solving for various industrial gas equipment and technologies, including cryogenic liquid bulk systems (LOX, LIN, LAR, MLX, MLN, LHY, and CO₂), Bulk Gaseous Systems, Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA), Membranes, Hydrogen Refueling Stations, and other Advanced Systems.

The position requires working overnight hours with four 10-hour shifts scheduled Thursday through Sunday. Because the Equipment Support Team delivers continuous support to customers and operations, being flexible and reliable is vital for success in this role. The role includes up to 5% domestic travel.

fbec5a4d8abba7b6d831.title: Procurement Category Manager - Structural Components
fbec5a4d8abba7b6d831.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

As a leading utility-scale renewable energy Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company, we are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Category Manager for Structural Components to lead sourcing, procurement, category strategy, and supplier relationship management across critical structural and construction equipment categories supporting solar PV, HV, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), and Services projects.
  
  
This role is responsible for developing and executing procurement strategies for structural commodities including trackers, fixed-tilt systems, foundations, steel components, and related construction materials, as well as major construction equipment used to build utility-scale renewable energy projects. Equipment categories may include, but will not be limited to, pile drivers, truss drivers, GPS guidance systems, and robotic conveyance/assembly equipment.
  
  
The Category Manager will partner closely with Engineering, Construction Operations, Fleet, Project Management, and Finance teams to drive supplier selection, execute strategic sourcing initiatives, negotiate commercial agreements, improve total cost of ownership, mitigate supply chain risks, and ensure equipment availability to support project execution.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in delivering competitive project economics, ensuring schedule certainty, and building long-term supplier partnerships that support the company's continued growth and industry leadership.
  
  
This role can be fully remote or hybrid with regular in-office presence in San Diego, CA. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

**Category Strategy & Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and execute category strategies for structural components and construction equipment aligned with business objectives, project pipelines, and market conditions.
* Lead supplier market analysis, benchmarking, and category intelligence efforts to identify opportunities for cost optimization, innovation, and risk mitigation.
* Partner with Engineering, Construction, Fleet, and Operations teams to define technical requirements, specifications, and sourcing strategies.
* Identify, qualify, and onboard new suppliers to support business growth, geographic expansion, and supply chain resiliency.
* Analyze total cost of ownership, supplier capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and commercial competitiveness when evaluating supplier options.

**Competitive Procurement & Contract Negotiation**

* Lead competitive RFP, RFQ, and bid processes for structural materials, construction equipment, and related services.
* Evaluate supplier proposals and develop recommendation packages utilizing commercial, technical, operational, and risk-based criteria.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, warranties, service agreements, performance guarantees, lead times, and other commercial terms.
* Develop and execute Master Supply Agreements, Strategic Partnership Agreements, Rental Agreements, Fleet Purchasing Agreements, and other procurement contracts.
* Support project-specific procurement activities to ensure timely delivery and alignment with project schedules.

**Construction Equipment Procurement**

* Lead sourcing and procurement of construction equipment supporting utility-scale renewable energy projects, including:
* Pile driving equipment
* Truss driving equipment
* GPS Guidance Systems
* Robotic Conveyance/Assembly equipment
* Evaluate buy versus lease versus rental strategies based on project duration, utilization, and financial objectives.
* Collaborate with Fleet and Operations teams to optimize equipment deployment, lifecycle costs, maintenance support, and asset utilization.
* Negotiate service, maintenance, warranty, and aftermarket support agreements with OEMs and equipment providers.
* Monitor equipment market trends, availability constraints, and technological advancements impacting project execution.

**Supplier Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary commercial interface for strategic suppliers.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and scorecards covering cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, safety, innovation, and sustainability.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive supplier meetings.
* Manage supplier escalations and drive corrective action plans when performance issues arise.
* Build strong collaborative supplier relationships that support continuous improvement and long-term value creation.

**Risk Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks related to capacity constraints, geopolitical factors, logistics disruptions, and commodity market fluctuations.
* Develop contingency sourcing plans for critical materials and equipment.
* Drive procurement process improvements, automation initiatives, and best practices.
* Support forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning activities.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, safety requirements, contractual obligations, and industry regulations.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, supply chain management, or supplier relationship management.
* Experience sourcing structural commodities, construction materials, industrial equipment, or capital equipment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex commercial negotiations and supplier agreements.
* Strong analytical, financial, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing cross-functional stakeholders and influencing executive-level decisions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.

* Experience within utility-scale solar, renewable energy, EPC, construction, infrastructure, energy, or industrial sectors.
* Experience sourcing heavy construction equipment, fleet assets, or large capital equipment programs.
* Understanding of solar tracker systems, foundations, steel fabrication, and renewable construction methodologies.
* Knowledge of equipment ownership models, fleet lifecycle management, rental strategies, and equipment financing structures.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPM, CSCP, PMP, or equivalent.

**Key Success Factors**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* Strategic procurement leadership.
* Strong commercial and contract negotiation expertise.
* Deep understanding of construction equipment and industrial supply markets.
* Ability to drive measurable cost savings and value creation.
* Expertise in supplier development and performance management.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset focused on supporting successful project execution.

3fe56b083c3d1cf38961.description:
### **About Point**

**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

**✨ Game-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

  

**Local or 100% Remote**

  

**About the role**

As a Servicing Operations Coordinator II at Point, you'll help homeowners navigate their Home Equity Investments (HEIs), providing clear, empathetic support and resolving complex servicing requests. From payoff inquiries and property sales to appraisal reviews and title-related questions, you'll coordinate with homeowners, external partners, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely resolutions.

This role combines customer service, document review, and problem-solving. You'll take ownership of servicing issues, maintain accurate records, and help improve workflows as our operations evolve. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to balance operational efficiency with a positive homeowner experience.

  

**Your responsibilities**

* Respond to homeowner inquiries regarding Home Equity Investments via phone, email, and internal servicing channels with professionalism, empathy, and accuracy.
* Handle more complex or escalated homeowner servicing requests, including payoff inquiries, appraisal reviews, title-related questions, sales transaction coordination, and servicing disputes.
* Make outbound calls to homeowners, real estate agents, escrow/title companies, insurance providers, and local counties as necessary to resolve servicing matters.
* Review and process HEI-related servicing documentation, including valuation reports, sales contracts, payoff requests, insurance documents, authorization forms, and other servicing records.
* Analyze sales contracts, appraisals, title information, and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, and servicing risk considerations.
* Support payoff and property sale workflows while ensuring adherence to servicing timelines and operational requirements.
* Assist homeowners facing financial or operational challenges with empathy, professionalism, and strong customer service.
* Investigate and resolve servicing exceptions, discrepancies, and operational issues with minimal supervision.
* Help identify process improvement opportunities and provide feedback on servicing workflows, tooling, and operational efficiencies.
* Utilize Point's proprietary servicing systems and operational tools to maintain accurate servicing records and ensure proper documentation.

  

**About you**

* Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently, solve problems, and use available resources effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, with confidence supporting homeowners by phone and email through both routine questions and escalated situations.
* A customer-focused, solutions-oriented approach that balances operational efficiency with empathy and a positive homeowner experience.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex servicing situations in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across teams to resolve issues and support homeowners.
* Curious and proactive in identifying knowledge gaps, training needs, and opportunities to improve servicing quality and workflows.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Nice to have**

* College degree in business, finance, or a related field preferred.
* Strong understanding of mortgage servicing operations and homeowner servicing processes.
* Familiarity with mortgage servicing regulations and consumer protection requirements, including RESPA, TILA, FDCPA, HPA, the SAFE Act, and UDAAP.

  

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

* Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $71,250 - $78,750
* Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $60,800 - $67,200
* Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $58,900 - $65,100

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

  

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point's states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

### **Our benefits**

* **Generous health benefits:** We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans with options for flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings accounts (HSA).
* **Unlimited paid time off:** Recharge with unlimited paid time off and 10 company holidays.
* **Flexible remote and onsite work:** Our teams work from many different locations and time zones. We support fully remote work and also have an amazing in-person environment in our downtown Palo Alto, CA HQ.
* **Fully paid parental leave:** Point will supplement state Paid Family Leave (PFL) so employees receive 100% of their regular base pay, plus two additional weeks of fully paid leave after state PFL ends. In states without PFL, Point offers up to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. In addition, employees also receive 4 weeks of fully paid transition time, during which you may work 2–3 days per week while receiving full base pay.
* **Equity:** We offer meaningful equity because we believe in sharing the value you help create. Your contributions directly impact our growth, and your equity gives you a stake in our future success.
* **Financial wellness:** We provide 401K retirement plans for employees as well as guaranteed life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
* **Extra work/life benefits:** We provide monthly stipends for internet, mobile plans, wellness perks, a one-time home office reimbursement, and company provided equipment including a MacBook and monitor.

  

Point is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. Each individual at Point brings their own perspectives, work experiences, lifestyles, and cultures with them, and we believe that a more diverse team creates more innovative products, provides better services to customers, and helps us all grow and learn.

* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.
* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.
