79e9961e02192df368eb.title: Xfinity Mobile Retail Service Associate -Part Time
79e9961e02192df368eb.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

The Retail Service Associate supports the store team in delivering a best-in-class customer experience across mobile, operational, and transactional activities. This role serves as a go-to technical and operational resource, helping to maintain a clean and efficient store environment, and provide exceptional customer support for mobile. RSAs handle mobile activation, education, troubleshooting, and escalations while assisting with operational priorities to ensure that customers leave confident and excited about their Comcast products and services.

**Job Description**

**Primary Responsibilities — Mobile Focused**

**Mobile Activations & Customer Education**

* Provide a white-glove experience activating new devices or BYOD to the network.
* Guide customers through tablet setup and connectivity options.
* Support activation and pairing of wearable devices for seamless use.
* Educate customers on accessories and add-ons that enhance their experience and drive incremental revenue.
* Demonstrate strong understanding and enthusiasm for technology and act as a go-to resource.
* Demonstrate basic features and capabilities of devices to increase customer confidence.

**Mobile Escalations**

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex device or service issues.
* Assist customers in securing accounts, replacing lost or stolen devices, and navigating access recovery.
* Use advanced tools to manage escalations.

**Mobile Support**

* Assist customers with transferring contacts, emails, and media.
* Provide password resets with appropriate credential verification.
* Activate and configure SIM or eSIM for device connectivity.
* Perform in-depth diagnostics to identify and resolve issues.
* Process returns or exchanges in compliance with company policies.
* Assist with warranty claims and replacement processes.
* Ensure devices, counters, accessories, and walkways are clean, functioning, and accessible.
* On-Demand Delivery, BAPIS & XM Upsell: Fulfill Xfinity Mobile on-demand deliveries and BAPIS pickups by staging orders accurately, ensuring smooth handoff, and identifying opportunities to upsell accessories or add-ons.

**Secondary Responsibilities — When No Primary Actions Occur or on Red Floor**

**Customer Check-In**

* Provide hands-on demonstrations of devices and features to enhance value.

**Operations**

* Support store resets for proper merchandising and operational readiness.
* Maintain visual standards and product placement for optimal customer experience.
* Inspect back-of-house to ensure clean, secure, and properly placed inventory.

**Express Transactions**

* Facilitate quick device swaps for customers.
* Process equipment returns efficiently while ensuring compliance.

**Expectations for All Employees**

* Understand and follow the Comcast Operating Principles.
* Own the customer experience and promote digital options at every touchpoint.
* Be an enthusiastic learner and advocate of Comcast products, services, and digital tools.
* Win as a team through collaboration and openness to new ideas.
* Participate in the Net Promoter System: huddles, callbacks, and feedback loops.
* Drive results and operational excellence.
* Foster and support a culture of inclusion.
* Do what’s right for customers, teammates, communities, and investors.

**Disclaimer**

This description outlines the general nature and level of work expected and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties or qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Skills:**

Customer-Focused; Workplace Organization; Technical Knowledge; Teamwork; Self Motivation; Critical Thinking Problem Solving; Communication; Resilience; Professional Integrity

**Salary:**

Base Pay: $17.00  
  
The application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

High School Diploma / GED

**Certifications (if applicable)**

0-2 Years

**Meet Vestis®:** For the People Who Make It All Work
  
At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
  
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
This versatile, hands-on role supports Vice President, Corp IT by connecting project and portfolio coordination, budgeting and financial administration, purchase and vendor management, reporting and dashboarding, data analysis, process improvement, team operations, and executive decision support. The position brings structure, visibility, and follow-through to a fast-moving technology organization by helping track priorities, budgets, risks, decisions, commitments, and key initiatives across the VP's portfolio. Leveraging judgment, discretion, communication, anticipation, and relationship management skills developed through executive support experience, the role serves as a trusted operational partner that helps turn strategy into execution
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
IT Project and Portfolio Management
  
  
Support VP Corp IT in tracking key technology initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, status updates, risks, actions, and dependencies across assigned platforms and business priorities.
  
  
Prepare project dashboards, reporting, and follow-up actions to help ensure deliverables, decisions, budgets, and stakeholder commitments remain on track.
  
  
Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders & Billing
  
  
Coordinate purchasing and invoicing activities for the technology portfolio by creating requisitions, tracking purchase orders, monitoring invoice processing, and maintaining spend visibility.
  
  
Maintain procurement and financial trackers while partnering with Finance, Procurement, Accounts Payable, and vendors to resolve issues and support budget administration activities.
  
  
Light Procurement & Vendor Administration
  
  
Support vendor and contract administration activities by coordinating renewals, collecting quotes, maintaining contract and subscription inventories, and monitoring key commercial dates and commitments.
  
  
Prepare vendor-related reporting and documentation while facilitating onboarding, compliance requirements, and routine procurement workflows in partnership with internal support teams.
  
  
Process Improvement & Automation
  
  
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve reporting, automate manual processes, and standardize operational practices.
  
  
Develop templates, trackers, and dashboards that improve efficiency and visibility.
  
  
IT, Business Operations Support
  
  
Serve as a trusted operational partner to the VP, Corp IT by preparing presentations, leadership materials, operating reviews, decision support documents, and executive communications.
  
  
Manage governance trackers, risks, actions, decisions, and special projects while coordinating follow-through across business, IT, vendor, and finance stakeholders.
  
  
Coordination & Workforce Assist
  
  
Support team operations for VP, Corp IT by maintaining resource, contractor, vendor, onboarding, offboarding, staffing, and workload progress trackers and dashboarding, and coordinating follow-up on key team commitments and deliverables.
  
  
Facilitate communication and operational alignment by coordinating team updates, communications, planning activities, action items, and accountability tracking to help ensure clear ownership, deadlines, and execution of priorities.
  
  
Reporting, Dashboarding & Business Insights
  
  
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting that provide visibility into project status, budgets, vendor performance, resource utilization, risks, milestones, and operational metrics across their manager’s technology portfolio.
  
  
Analyze and consolidate data from multiple sources to prepare leadership-ready reports, trend analysis, executive summaries, and insights that support planning, prioritization, and decision-making.
  
  
Success Profile & Executive Support Strengths
  
  
A trusted, low-ego operator who can move fluidly between project delivery, analytics, financial detail, team coordination, and executive communication. The person is equally comfortable building a dashboard, reconciling a PO, organizing an intake pipeline, preparing a decision brief, or driving follow-up across stakeholders.
  
  
Executive judgment and prioritization.
  
  
Discretion with confidential financial, vendor, personnel, and strategic information.
  
  
Enterprise perspective and understanding of cross-functional dependencies.
  
  
Clear, concise writing and presentation development.
  
  
Anticipation, responsiveness, and disciplined follow-through.
  
  
Confident stakeholder navigation across levels and functions.
  
  
Ability to create structure from ambiguity.
  
  
Meeting preparation, decision capture, and action follow-up, excluding scheduling.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
5+ years in IT project management, portfolio operations, analytics, financial administration, executive operations, or a comparable cross-functional role.
  
  
Experience managing projects, risks, issues, dependencies, actions, vendors, and executive reporting.
  
  
Hands-on experience producing dashboards, analyses, management reports, and decision-support materials.
  
  
Working knowledge of budgets, forecasts, requisitions, POs, invoices, accruals, billing, and reconciliations.
  
  
Advanced Excel capability, including lookups, pivot tables, validation, reconciliation, and analysis of imperfect data.
  
  
Strong communication across IT, business, Finance, Procurement, vendor, and executive audiences.
  
  
Exceptional organization, detail, discretion, judgment, and independent prioritization.
  
  
Ability to move between strategic priorities and detailed execution.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Prior operational or analytical support to a senior IT executive or leader.
  
  
Experience in logistics, distribution, field services, or another complex enterprise environment.
  
  
Power BI or comparable business intelligence experience.
  
  
IT portfolio, demand management, technology procurement, vendor management, or IT financial management experience.
  
  
Familiarity with ERP, procurement, project management, service management, and collaboration platforms.
  
  
PMP, Agile, business analysis, analytics, or Lean certification is a plus.
  
  
Software / Tools
  
  
Microsoft 365, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
  
  
Power BI or comparable visualization tools
  
  
Azure DevOps, Jira, Microsoft Project, Planner, Smartsheet, or similar
  
  
SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Ariba, or comparable ERP and procurement tools
  
  
ServiceNow or similar workflow and service management tools
  
  
Visio or Lucidchart
  
  
Working Environment/Physical Requirements
  
  
Hybrid or remote work schedule/ environment; up to 20% travel may be required.
  
  
This position requires availability during standard Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

86fda8689664ed3ca69f.title: Client Concierge & Administrative Coordinator
86fda8689664ed3ca69f.description:
Boudoir by Court is an established luxury boudoir photography studio dedicated to empowering women, celebrating confidence, and creating unforgettable experiences.

With studio locations in North Carolina, Washington State, and the United Kingdom, we specialize in providing a personalized, luxury photography experience from the very first inquiry to the final delivery of our clients' beautiful images.

We are a growing business looking for an enthusiastic, motivated, and highly personable individual to join our team as a **Client Concierge & Administrative Coordinator**.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who loves connecting with people, thrives in a positive environment, and enjoys being part of a creative, female-focused business.

Our Client Concierge is often the first point of contact for potential and existing clients. We're looking for someone who can make every woman feel welcomed, comfortable, excited, and confident throughout her experience with us.

**Exceptional phone communication skills are an absolute must.** A significant portion of this position involves speaking directly with clients, answering questions, following up with inquiries, and helping prospective clients take the next step toward booking their photography experience.

The position is approximately 95% administrative and client-focused, with occasional opportunities to assist during photography sessions for candidates located near one of our studios.

Key Responsibilities

* Communicate with prospective and existing clients through phone calls, emails, and text messages.
* Conduct client follow-ups and assist with converting inquiries into confirmed bookings.
* Provide outstanding customer service while maintaining a warm, encouraging, and professional attitude.
* Manage client scheduling, appointments, and general administrative tasks.
* Assist with social media management, content scheduling, and engagement.
* Help create and publish blog posts and other marketing content.
* Maintain organized client records and assist with day-to-day business operations.
* Support promotional campaigns, special offers, and other marketing initiatives.
* Occasionally assist with photography sessions and studio operations if local.

Who We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys working with people and brings a positive, can-do attitude to everything they do.

**You would be a great fit if you are:**

* **Exceptional on the phone:** Confident, personable, articulate, and comfortable having conversations with new people.
* **Naturally encouraging:** You love uplifting others and helping women feel confident and comfortable.
* **Sales-minded:** Comfortable discussing services, following up with prospective clients, and helping turn inquiries into bookings.
* **Self-motivated:** Capable of working independently, managing your time, and taking initiative without constant supervision.
* **Highly organized:** Able to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and maintain excellent attention to detail.
* **Tech-savvy:** Comfortable learning new software, client management systems, and digital platforms.
* **Creative:** Interested in social media, marketing, content creation, and the photography industry.
* **Reliable and professional:** Someone we can count on to represent our brand with care, consistency, and enthusiasm.

Previous experience in sales, customer service, administrative support, or client relations is strongly preferred.

Experience with CRM software, social media management, and online scheduling systems is a plus.

Schedule & Compensation

* Approximately 20-30 hours per week, with potential for additional hours as the business grows.
* $18.00 per hour.
* Opportunities for additional performance-based bonuses tied to company sales goals and individual performance.
* Primarily remote work, with availability required during scheduled U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
* For candidates located near our North Carolina, occasional in-person work may be requested, typically 2–3 times per month. NOT required.

Before You Apply

Boudoir photography is a unique and personal experience, and we're passionate about creating a welcoming, judgment-free environment where women of all backgrounds, shapes, and sizes feel celebrated.

If you're someone who loves connecting with people, enjoys encouraging other women, and would be excited to help grow a luxury photography business, we'd love to hear from you!

Pay: $18.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**Job description:**

**Overview**  
Fundelivered is hiring an experienced, full-time, fully remote Executive Assistant & Sourcing Coordinator to work directly with our two co-founders! We’re a fast-growing mystery box company recently featured on ABC’s Shark Tank. As we enter our next chapter of growth, we’re looking for a highly organized, proactive right hand who can hit the ground running and keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

You’ll manage day-to-day communication and scheduling, handle invoices and payments, keep projects moving across our teams, and help us source new products and build strong relationships with our vendors. This role will become more robust as we scale, with opportunities to take on more responsibility, including helping select and buy products. Pay is $62,000–$102,000 per year, depending on experience.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage and organize the co-founders’ inboxes, flag priorities and respond on their behalf when needed.
* Schedule and coordinate meetings, calls and appointments, and keep calendars organized.
* Take notes during meetings, track action items and follow up to make sure things get done.
* Create and manage invoices, purchase orders, bills and payments, track expenses and follow up to keep everything current.
* Review supplier catalogs and inventory lists, research products, request quotes and narrow down the best options for our boxes.
* Over time, learn our buying process and help select products to purchase.
* Help build and maintain strong relationships with our vendors and suppliers.
* Research and find new outlets for leftover or unusable product, such as resellers and donation partners.
* Post and manage job listings for open positions.
* Communicate with internal teams to keep plans and initiatives on track and make sure everyone is on the same page.
* Act as a point of contact for vendors, partners and other contacts on behalf of the co-founders.
* Prepare and proofread emails, documents and simple reports, and keep files organized.
* Coordinate occasional travel, trade shows and events as needed.
* Help with special projects and whatever else comes up in a fast-moving business.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience as an executive assistant, operations coordinator or similar role, ideally supporting founders or senior leadership.
* Experience handling invoices, purchase orders, bills and payments. QuickBooks or similar experience is preferred.
* Highly organized, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, professional and friendly.
* Proactive and resourceful. You see what needs to be done and handle it without being asked.
* Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs) and video calls like Zoom or Google Meet.
* Good judgment and discretion when communicating on behalf of leadership and handling confidential and financial information.
* Interest in products, retail or e-commerce, and an eye for what makes a great item.
* Experience in retail, merchandising, buying, resale or e-commerce is a plus.
* Experience with project tracking tools (Asana, Trello, Monday, etc.) or DocuSign is a plus.
* Reliable home office setup with high-speed internet.
* Able to visit our Ocala warehouse occasionally is a plus, but not required.

**Job Type:** Full-time, remote

**Pay:** $62,000–$89,000 per year, depending on experience

**Benefits:**

* Monthly health reimbursement allowance toward your own health plan
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
* Flexible schedule
* Fully remote work

**How to Apply**  
Please email jenabutler@fundelivered.com with the subject line **“Executive Assistant & Sourcing Coordinator”** and include:

* Your resume
* A short cover note (a few paragraphs is perfect) that answers:
* Why are you excited about this role and Fundelivered?
* Tell us about a time you took something off a busy leader’s plate and ran with it.
* What experience do you have with invoicing, bookkeeping, buying or vendor relationships?

Applications without a cover note will not be considered.

If you’re an experienced, detail-driven professional who loves keeping things organized, enjoys being the person who makes everything run smoothly and has an eye for great products, we’d love to hear from you!

Pay: $62,000.00 - $89,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

**Position:** Administrative Assistant

**Job Type:** Full-time, non-exempt

**\*\* RESUMES WITHOUT A COVER LETTER WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED \*\***

**About Us:**

The Crime Victims Council (CVC) has been serving victims of crime in Lehigh and Northampton Counties since 1973. We are a compassionate team of counselors, advocates and educators serving victims of all violence along with their families and significant others. All programs and services of CVC are confidential and offered at no cost to our clients. Services include counseling; hospital, police, and court accompaniment; 24-hour hotline, and community education and prevention programs.

**Position:**

The Administrative Assistant provides administrative and organizational support to ensure the effective day-to-day operations of the agency. This position serves as a welcoming and professional point of contact for clients, community partners, and visitors, while assisting with scheduling, communication, recordkeeping, data entry, and general office functions. The Administrative Assistant is expected to maintain a high level of confidentiality, professionalism, organization, and sensitivity, recognizing the unique needs of individuals impacted by trauma and victimization. This role works collaboratively with staff across departments and contributes to maintaining a supportive, trauma-informed, and client-centered environment.

**REQUIREMENTS**: Associates degree preferred.

**Qualifications:**

* Administrative training required, preferably, an associate degree.
* Strong organizational and administrative skills, attention to detail, ability to multi-task.
* Professional demeanor and ability to maintain confidentiality in the work environment.
* Exhibits compassion and understanding of the impacts of interpersonal violence on individuals and families.
* Demonstrates cultural humility, an understanding of systems of oppression, and a commitment to personal growth in skills and attitudes that promote equality and inclusion.
* Demonstrates ability to create and maintain collaborative relationships with coworkers, key stakeholders, and outside entities.
* Successful completion of the 40hr sexual assault counselor training provided by CVC.
* Must be able to provide FBI Criminal Clearance, PA State Police Criminal Clearance, and Child Abuse History Clearance.
* Valid driver’s license and working vehicle required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Arranges for appropriate service and maintenance of office equipment and systems.
* Maintain professional and orderly space in CVC’s Allentown and Bethlehem offices as well as storage areas.
* Manages office supplies inventory and submits` orders as needed.
* Answers the office phone line, takes messages, transfers calls to other staff, and provides general information and referrals to clients.
* Provides on-going services to clients such as crisis intervention, hospital, police, and court accompaniment, and advocacy services.
* Help to maintain 24-hour hotline coverage, including on-call duties and after-hours support on a rotational basis.
* Provides administrative support as needed for Executive Director & Director of Finance.
* Records and distributes monthly staff meeting minutes.
* Ensure that office extensions & staff phone number lists are up to date.
* Opens, dates, and distributes all mail daily.
* Maintains office filing system.
* Submits bi-weekly timesheets and monthly grant and data tracking documentation to the Associate Director.
* Manages time sheets, grant tracking sheets, and PTO calculators’ staff wide.
* Provides general supportive hotline counseling to clients over the phone and in the waiting room when necessary.
* Contributes with intention to a positive and supportive agency culture based on care, trust, and our shared values.
* Assists and participates in agency events and activities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What We Offer:**

**Great Work Environment and Benefits.** Crime Victims Council provides a supportive, collaborative work environment that focuses on the growth and development of employees. Benefits include:

* Generous PTO package
* Health, Dental, Life, and LTD insurance
* 13 major paid holidays
* Paid hour break
* Self-care and employee appreciation activities
* 403B Plan Enrollment and Employer Contribution after 1 year of full-time employment

\*Successful applicants must be able to provide current Pennsylvania State Police Criminal Clearance, FBI Criminal Clearance/Fingerprinting, and Child Abuse History Clearance.

**Directly Reports To:** The Associate Director

**Salary:** $37,000 - $39,000 per year

**Please submit a cover letter and resume to Kelsey Savarese, Associate Director at KSavarese@cvclv.org**

Pay: $37,000.00 - $39,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Job Description: RCM Administrative Coordinator

**Job title:** Air Ambulance Revenue Cycle Specialist (Claims Triage and Payment Posting)

**Schedule:** Full-time, Eastern Time (ET) schedule

**Reports to:** Chief Financial Officer

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced professional with experience in an air ambulance program to review completed air transports, determine the right billing path for each, and keep payment posting and account balances accurate. This role applies strong knowledge of air ambulance regulatory requirements, including NSA CMS regulations. It also serves as a key point of contact among our internal teams, partners, and external billing vendor.

Key Responsibilities

* Review completed air transports promptly to determine which claims are handled in-house and which are sent to the external billing vendor.

* Apply NSA, CMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements to claim review, routing, and account handling.

* Post payments, adjustments, and denials from payor EOBs accurately and in a timely manner.

* Reconcile account balances with the accounting department and resolve discrepancies.

* Identify and resolve balance issues, including credit balances, unposted contractual allowances, and posting errors.

* Coordinate with internal team members, partners, and the external billing vendor to keep accounts moving and communication clear.

* Maintain accurate documentation and follow-up on accounts so nothing is missed.

* Support the accuracy of AR reporting.

* Manage credentialing for existing and new payor contracts.

Required Qualifications

* Previous experience working in an air ambulance organization.

* Solid working knowledge of air ambulance regulatory requirements, including NSA and CMS.

* Experience posting payments and denials from payor EOBs.

* Experience reconciling balances with an accounting department.

* Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work an Eastern Time schedule.

Core Competencies

* **Flexibility:** Adapts quickly to changing priorities and works effectively across multiple teams and partners.

* **Professionalism:** Stays composed, diplomatic, and solution-focused when working with tight deadlines and high-pressure situations.

* **Attention to detail:** Ensures posting and balance accuracy.

* **Collaboration:** Builds productive working relationships with internal staff, partners, and vendors.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 60.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

**Executive Assistant to the CEO**

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, extremely organized, resourceful Executive Assistant to support the CEO and keep the day-to-day running smoothly. This role goes beyond managing a calendar: you’ll anticipate needs, bring structure to competing priorities, and help the CEO stay focused on the work that matters most.

The ideal candidate is a clear communicator who exercises good judgment, handles sensitive information with discretion, and takes ownership from start to finish. You’re comfortable working independently, asking thoughtful questions, and adapting when priorities change.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manage the CEO’s time and priorities**

· Own a dynamic calendar, balancing meetings, focused work, travel, and shifting priorities.

· Evaluate scheduling requests, resolve conflicts, and make thoughtful recommendations about how to use the CEO’s time.

· Keep the CEO informed of upcoming commitments, deadlines, and decisions that need attention.

**Support communication and relationships**

· Help organize and prioritize email and other communications, flagging urgent items and drafting responses as appropriate.

· Serve as a responsive, professional point of contact for internal team members and external partners.

· Prepare correspondence, presentations, and other materials with accuracy and attention to detail.

**Create structure and improve how work gets done**

· Create and maintain organized administrative systems and processes.

· Build simple, repeatable processes that reduce back-and-forth and make daily work easier.

· Support research and special projects.

· Handle confidential business, human resources, and personal information with complete discretion.

**Keep on top of To-Do’s and keep deliverables & tasks on track**

· Coordinate meetings and ensure agendas, relevant documents, and preparation materials are ready in advance.

· Capture key decisions and action items when needed, and track owners and deadlines.

· Follow up thoughtfully to keep commitments moving and prevent important details from being missed.

**Coordinate travel and administrative needs**

· Arrange travel, accommodations, transportation, and create clear itineraries.

· Manage expense reports and related administrative tasks.

· Coordinate logistics for leadership meetings, team gatherings, and other events as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

· 10+ years experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in an executive assistant role.

· Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of details.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Sound judgment about what to handle independently, what to flag, and when to ask for clarification.

· A proactive approach: you anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and bring practical solutions.

· Reliable follow-through and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

· Comfort working remotely and building effective relationships across internal teams and clients.

· Proficiency with MS products, calendar, email, presentations, and video conferencing tools, plus a willingness to learn new systems.

For each, explain why you consider it important and how you demonstrate it through your experience or approach to work.

* Experience managing confidential information and matters

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.
* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.
* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).

**Operations**

* Provides customers with courteous, friendly, fast, and efficient service.
* Recommends items for sale to customer and recommends trade-up and/or companion items.
* Registers customer purchases on assigned cash register, collects cash and distributes change as requested; processes voids, returns, rain checks, refunds, and exchanges as needed. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible to assist in locating products.
* Keeps counters and shelves clean and well merchandised, takes inventory, and maintains records. Checks in and prices merchandise as required or as directed by store manager or communicated by the shift leader.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.

* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.

* Constructs and maintains displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions as directed.
* Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottom shelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.

The Plumbers Guild is a plumbing service company looking for a dependable person to answer customer calls, coordinate appointments and keep job records organized.

You will work directly with the owner and field technicians.

We provide training in Housecall Pro and company AI tools.

PAY AND SCHEDULE

$18–$22 per hour, depending on relevant experience.

Monday: 8 AM–5 PM Eastern, with a one-hour lunch covered by the company.

Tuesday–Friday: 1–5 PM Eastern.

Approximately 24 paid hours per week.

No regular evening or weekend shifts.

You must be available and working during scheduled hours.

This role starts part time.

There may be an opportunity for more hours or a full-time role as the business grows, based on business needs and performance.

Additional hours are not guaranteed.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Answer customer calls professionally and return missed calls promptly during your shift.

Gather customer information and the problem, check booking rules and technician availability, and schedule suitable appointments.

Ask whether the customer has other plumbing concerns to pass to the technician.

Keep records accurate, including how the customer heard about us, technician assignment, notes, photos, receipts and documented provider agreements.

Use company AI tools to check records, draft routine responses and identify missing information.

Verify results and follow through until missing items are resolved.

Coordinate customer updates and technician handoffs.

WHAT YOU NEED

Clear, professional phone manner and strong spoken and written English.

Dependable attendance, accurate record keeping and follow-through without repeated reminders.

Experience in customer service, scheduling, dispatch or office administration.

Plumbing or home service experience is helpful but not required.

Your own reliable laptop or desktop computer, headset with microphone, stable internet and quiet workspace.

A smartphone for company app access and account verification.

We do not provide a computer or phone.

Customer calls use the company phone system, not your personal number.

Comfort learning Housecall Pro and using AI tools.

No programming experience required.

You must check AI output rather than assume it is correct.

Respect for customer information and company account security.

The computer is the primary workstation.

The mobile app does not replace being at your workstation and available during your shift.

Remote work with a consistent weekday schedule, paid training, direct support from the owner, company access to necessary software and AI tools, and an opportunity for more responsibility as the business grows.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note about relevant experience.

6eefeeaaa3b5f7232c9c.description:
**Logistics Coordinator - Job Overview:**

The primary responsibility of a Logistics Coordinator is to manage the daily operational requirements of the freight brokerage while developing strong carrier relationships and supporting the transportation needs of assigned customers. This role requires a thorough understanding of the transportation market, carrier capacity, pricing, and the operational requirements necessary to execute shipments successfully. Success in this role will be achieved by proactively managing shipments from booking through delivery, developing a reliable network of carrier partners, negotiating competitive rates, and maintaining consistent communication with carriers and customers. The Logistics Coordinator will take ownership of daily operational challenges while working closely with the Account Management and Business Development teams to ensure customer expectations are met and transportation solutions are executed effectively. This role is focused on operational execution, carrier development, and the ongoing management of existing customer relationships. The Logistics Coordinator is expected to understand assigned customers' businesses, identify opportunities to improve service and efficiency, and help WHY Logistics deliver transportation solutions that balance cost, service, and profitability.

**Responsibilities**

**Transportation Operations**

* Proactively manage daily shipment activity and ensure carriers meet scheduled pickup and delivery appointments.
* Coordinate and oversee the operational execution of shipments from carrier booking through final delivery.
* Monitor shipment status and maintain communication with carriers to ensure timely and accurate updates.
* Identify, communicate, and resolve shipment delays, service failures, scheduling conflicts, and exceptions.
* Manage multiple shipments and priorities simultaneously with a strong sense of urgency and accountability.
* Ensure all shipment details, milestones, and documentation are accurately maintained in the company's Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Follow established operating procedures and customer-specific requirements to ensure consistent execution.
* Take ownership of operational issues and work proactively to minimize disruption to customers.

**Carrier Development**

* Identify, qualify, and develop relationships with reliable carrier partners to support customer transportation requirements.
* Negotiate carrier rates and secure capacity while maintaining service expectations and company profitability.
* Maintain regular communication with carrier partners to strengthen relationships and improve service reliability.
* Monitor carrier performance, address service issues, and identify opportunities to improve carrier utilization.
* Maintain an understanding of current transportation market conditions, capacity trends, and rate fluctuations.
* Develop strategies to secure reliable capacity during market disruptions, and challenging freight conditions.
* Ensure carrier qualification, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before assigning shipments.

**Account Management**

* Develop a thorough understanding of assigned customers' businesses, requirements, and service expectations.
* Work with the Account Management team to ensure customer transportation needs are met effectively.
* Provide timely and accurate communication of shipment status, service exceptions, and corrective actions.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation processes, service levels, carrier selection, and cost efficiency.
* Understand WHY Logistics' approach, differentiation, and drive value through daily execution.
* Build trust with customers through accountability, responsiveness, and a commitment to resolving problems.
* Support customer onboarding, transportation bids, routing changes, and new service implementations as needed.
* Communicate recurring customer challenges and potential service improvements to internal team members.
* Help maintain and strengthen existing customer relationships through consistent operational performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Interested in building a career with a growth-oriented company.
* Driven, competitive, naturally passionate, and curious.
* Business-minded, with the ability to balance customer service, operational execution, and profitability.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to learn and absorb information quickly.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Team player who can also produce independent results and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Bachelor's degree or relevant equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years of logistics operations, carrier development, transportation brokerage, or related experience preferred.
* Understanding of truckload transportation, LTL, carrier procurement, and freight brokerage operations preferred.
* Ability to evaluate carrier pricing, market conditions, capacity, and service requirements.
* Strong analytical, mathematical, and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Transportation Management System (TMS) experience preferred.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, carriers, and internal team members.
* Travel Expectation – none required.

**Employee Expectations:**

* **Build Relationships for Impactful Growth** – Develop meaningful relationships with carriers, customers, and coworkers that strengthen WHY Logistics' ability to deliver reliable transportation solutions.
* **Tackle Challenges and Drive Solutions** – Take ownership of operational challenges, identify the root cause of problems, and proactively develop solutions that protect customer service and company profitability.
* **Gain Ground Through Incremental Development** – Continuously improve transportation knowledge, carrier negotiation skills, market awareness, customer understanding, and operational execution.
* **Embrace the Grind** – Understand that successful freight brokerage requires consistent communication, proactive follow-up, attention to detail, and a willingness to do what is necessary to serve customers and support the team.
* Maintain a high sense of urgency when managing shipments, securing capacity, communicating with carriers, and resolving operational exceptions.
* Build carrier relationships based on trust, communication, and mutually beneficial business opportunities.
* Take accountability for assigned shipments and customer requirements from booking through final delivery.
* Make informed decisions that balance customer expectations, carrier performance, transportation costs, and company profitability.
* Communicate proactively, professionally, and transparently with customers, carriers, and coworkers.
* Demonstrate initiative by identifying potential problems before they escalate and recommending solutions.
* Protect the reputation and profitability of WHY Logistics through responsible carrier selection, thoughtful rate negotiation, and consistent operational execution.

### **A Little Bit About Us**

We offer exceptional vacation homes across the country's most celebrated ski towns and coastal retreats. Each property is carefully selected, locally managed, and held to an uncompromising standard of care. We live and work in the communities we serve, which means every stay comes with generous local knowledge, genuine hospitality, and the confidence that what you booked is exactly what you'll find.

Health, Dental & Vision Insurance  
401(k) with Company Match

Paid Sick Leave

*Benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents, which govern in the event of any discrepancy. The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate benefit plans and programs at any time.*

**About This Job**

The Reputation Management Coordinator supports key administrative and operational processes that contribute to a positive guest experience and effective property management operations. This role is responsible for managing guest reviews and ratings, coordinating follow-up on guest concerns, and supporting the end-to-end unit termination and offboarding process.

Working cross-functionally with local market teams and other internal partners, this position helps ensure guest feedback is addressed appropriately, outstanding concerns are followed through to resolution, and departing units are accurately and efficiently transitioned out of First Chair Destinations' systems and operations.

**Compensation + Schedule**

* $20 - $23 / HR less payroll deductions and all required withholdings
* Monday - Friday schedule
* Fully remote
* Weekends and holidays may be required

**Essential Job Functions**

**Guest Reviews & Reputation Management**

* Manage guest reviews and ratings across applicable platforms, including reviewing incoming feedback, rating guests, and responding to guest reviews in a timely and professional manner.
* Ensure review responses reflect First Chair Destinations' service standards, brand voice, and commitment to the guest experience.
* Identify guest feedback that requires additional follow-up or escalation and coordinate with the appropriate local or internal teams.
* Track outstanding guest concerns and follow through with responsible teams to help ensure issues are appropriately addressed and resolved.
* Identify recurring themes or trends in guest feedback and elevate insights as appropriate to support service and operational improvements.

**Guest Concern Coordination**

* Partner with local market teams to address guest concerns identified through reviews, ratings, or other feedback channels.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up between teams when multiple departments are involved in resolving a guest issue.
* Maintain visibility into open concerns and help ensure agreed-upon actions are completed.
* Document relevant resolutions and follow-up activity as needed.

#### **Unit Terminations & Offboarding**

* Coordinate the full unit termination and offboarding workflow from notification through completion.
* Complete required system updates and administrative steps associated with removing units from the First Chair Destinations portfolio.
* Maintain accurate and complete documentation throughout the termination process.
* Coordinate with local teams and applicable internal departments to ensure required offboarding activities are completed on schedule.
* Track unit terminations through completion, following up on outstanding tasks and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.
* Help ensure internal systems, records, and documentation accurately reflect the final status of terminated units.

**General Functions**

* Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing program performance, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing process optimizations. Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to the function.
* Contribute to a collaborative work environment that promotes open communication, innovation, and employee engagement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align departmental goals with broader organizational strategy.
* *Other duties as assigned because every day is different in hospitality!*

**Skills + Qualifications**

* Experience working in hotel, hospitality, vacation or similar industry is highly preferred.
* College education is strongly preferred, though we recognize that great talent comes from many different paths.
* Minimum 2 years of experience within a similar guest / customer facing support role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workflows, deadlines, and follow-up items simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when completing system updates and maintaining documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple teams and follow issues through to resolution.
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling guest concerns and sensitive information.
* Tech-savvy with experience using various digital systems and applications and comfortable using mobile apps, tablets, and various software platforms.
* Comfortable talking to people—online or in person—and being able to share information in a way that's clear, thoughtful, and easy to understand.

**Workplace Environment + Physical Requirements**

* Fully remote work environment with reliable internet connection.
* Reliable transportation required.
* Typically a Monday - Friday workweek with expectations to be flexible to support the needs of the business.

*This job description does not identify every requirement of the position. First Chair may change position requirements, responsibilities, and work environment at any time with or without notice.*

*Some positions may require that you drive a personal vehicle and/or company vehicle for work purposes. Employees who are required to drive a personal vehicle must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license, and be at least 18 years of age. Employees who are required to drive a company vehicle must have a valid driver's license, be at least 21 years of age, and have been a licensed driver for no less than 3 years.*

*An offer of employment for this role will be contingent upon the successful completion of* *a background check.*

**About Us**

Martin is a leading insurance advisory and consulting firm celebrating over 30 years in business. We support many national, regional, and local insurance carriers and managing general agents (MGA) throughout the US. Our insurance services focus on our client’s most important initiatives and opportunities: capacity, resources, operations, technology, due diligence, service, and practical advice. At Martin & Company, our goal is to build strong, lasting relationships with partners who share our values, vision, and commitment to mutual success.

**The Opportunity**

As the Director of our newly formed Professional Services Group (PSG), you will be the consulting lead for a portfolio of key client accounts. You will make sure every engagement is well scoped, meets Martin's quality standards, and delivers the outcomes we promised our clients.

In this role, you help define what great looks like. You set the requirements and standards for each engagement before our Operations team staffs and executes the work. That frees you to focus on what matters most: understanding client needs, scoping work precisely, safeguarding quality, and growing long-term client relationships.

This role is ideal for an experienced P&C insurance consultant who combines deep domain expertise with executive presence, enjoys leading senior client relationships, and wants to help shape a growing professional services practice. This is a remote position reporting to our Chief Professional Services Officer. Limited travel may be required for client meetings and company events.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Scoping and Business Development*

Discovery and scoping: Lead discovery and scoping for new opportunities, defining client requirements, deliverables, and delivery assumptions.

Deal review: Represent the Professional Services Group in reviews of complex or nonstandard engagements before commitments are made.

Scope management: Own changes to engagement scope, partnering with Sales on pricing and with Operations on capacity and timing.

*Client Leadership*

Trusted advisor: Serve as the primary consulting contact and a trusted advisor for your client accounts, including ongoing support for our largest clients.

Account growth: Lead value-focused renewal conversations and identify follow-on work and opportunities to expand client relationships.

Client outcomes: Make sure every client sees measurable value from their engagement with Martin.

*Quality and Standards*

Peer review: Conduct quality reviews on large and first-time projects before they are delivered to clients.

Continuous improvement: Maintain and improve the quality checklists used on routine work, and capture lessons learned across engagements.

*Partnership and Practice Building*

Delivery partnership: Provide clearly scoped work to our Operations team regarding client deliverables. Collaborate with Operations, provide input on staffing for key accounts, and partner on milestones, expectations, and project health.

Practice development: Contribute to consulting methodologies, playbooks, and reusable assets, and identify services that could be standardized or productized.

Mentorship: Mentor consultants in P&C domain knowledge and consultative skills.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 10+ years of experience in P&C insurance, including at least 5 years leading client-facing consulting engagements
* Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, including product development, regulatory compliance, and state filings
* Proven success scoping complex engagements and managing scope throughout delivery
* Executive presence and the credibility to advise, and constructively push back with, senior client stakeholders
* A track record of setting clear standards and leading through others
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Attention to detail and quality
* Experience with simultaneously managing multiple projects and stakeholders

*Preferred*

* Experience at a consulting firm, carrier, or MGA serving multiple insurance lines
* Experience supporting technology-enabled services, platforms, or software implementations
* Experience building consulting methodologies, playbooks, or quality programs
* Experience and desire to be a People Manager is a plus, as this role will grow to have direct reports

**Why Join Us?**

**Growth-Oriented Culture:** Work with a leadership team committed to innovation and revenue expansion.

**Competitive Earning Potential:** Base salary plus bonus potential, profit sharing, and a comprehensive benefits package that rewards expertise and contributions.

**Legacy of Excellence:** Be part of a well-respected organization with over 30 years of leadership in the insurance industry.

**Dynamic Team Culture:** Work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate, driven, and committed to success.

**Salary and Benefits**

The base salary for this position is $120,000 to $150,000. Final salary offer will be based on several factors, including commensurate experience, qualifications, and skills. Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. These benefits include:

cb37e28f9cd03c571415.description:
Position Information

**Position Title:**

Credit for Prior Learning and Career Progression Coordinator

  

**Posting Number:**

WPU0065217

  

**University Information:**

William Peace University (“Peace”) provides a culture that fosters an energized team environment, builds on our strengths, promotes creativity and innovation, and encourages respect and open communication. We value our faculty and staff. We know they are important and vital to the growth of our university and culture. Senior leadership is personally dedicated to the professional growth and development of each employee. We want to help you build your career, while ensuring you have great work-life balance and flexibility.
  
  
We teach our students the skills needed for ethical citizenship, not just in the classroom, but by example. We believe in giving back to our community, and our employees take pride in working at Peace.

  

**Department:**

Academic Affairs

  

**Purpose of Department:**

Housed within the Academic Affairs division, Peace Online advances William Peace University’s mission by expanding access to high-quality, flexible, and student-centered educational opportunities for online, adult, working, transfer, military-connected, and other nontraditional learners. The department supports students from inquiry through graduation by coordinating enrollment, academic success, career progression, retention, and completion efforts for online and adult-learning programs.

  

**Summary of Position:**

The Credit for Prior Learning and Career Progression Coordinator supports all William Peace University students, with a primary focus on Peace Online and military-connected learners. The position provides leadership for the development, implementation, and ongoing coordination of Peace’s Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) process, ensuring that students can translate prior learning into academic progress. In collaboration with Academic Affairs, the Registrar, Financial Aid, advising, Peace Online, Career Services, and faculty, the Coordinator ensures that approved credit is accurately applied and that students receive coaching for career advancement, job search strategies, and transition into new roles. The position offers specialized resources, orientation, and career guidance tailored to the unique needs of military-connected and veteran students while remaining an accessible resource for all learners across the university.

  

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**

**CPL** **policy and process management**

* Lead the development and implementation of institutional CPL policies, procedures, forms, and workflows in collaboration with Academic Affairs partners.
* Coordinate the student-facing CPL process, including outreach, intake, document collection, case tracking, and communication with students, advisors, and faculty reviewers.
* Serve as a liaison among academic departments, Academic Advising, the Registrar, Financial Aid, and student support offices to ensure accurate evaluation, transcription, and application of CPL credit.
* Coordinate with the School Certifying Official to ensure that prior training and credit for students using VA education benefits are evaluated and documented as required.
* Ensure CPL policies and processes adhere to institutional policies, academic standards, and accreditation requirements, including requirements for credit evaluation, documentation, and degree completion
  

  

**Prior learning evaluation support**

* Support and manage evaluation pathways for prior learning, including military transcripts (e.g., the Joint Services Transcript and American Council on Education credit recommendations), industry certifications, employer training, portfolio assessment, and other approved forms of CPL.
* Assist with the development of department-approved review rubrics, documentation practices, and equitable assessment processes aligned with program and course outcomes.
* Advise students on available CPL options and help them understand how prior learning can accelerate academic progress, reduce duplicative coursework, and support degree completion.
* Coordinate evaluation requests with faculty and academic departments, monitor review timelines, and communicate requirements, status updates, and decisions to students.
* Collaborate with faculty, the Registrar, and academic advisors to ensure approved CPL credit is accurately documented, recorded, and applied to students’ degree requirements.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of CPL best practices, accreditation requirements, and state/federal guidelines.
  

  

**Career progression support**

* Provide high-impact, individualized career progression coaching for Peace Online students and other adult learners, extending the reach of Career Services to learners not typically served by campus-based programming, including career exploration, advancement planning, resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and job search strategy.
* Help students translate workplace and military experience into academic pathways and career goals, including support for career transition and advancement.
* Develop and maintain student-facing resources, workshops, and advising materials related to career progression, CPL opportunities, and pathways for online and military-connected learners.
* Partner with Career Services, Peace Online staff, and faculty to embed career progression and CPL conversations into advising, new student orientation, and program completion for online and military-connected learners.
  

  

**Collaboration and campus training**

* Collaborate with the Director of Career Design and Employer Engagement to connect Peace Online students and other learners with internships, virtual opportunities, employer networks, and career-connected learning experiences.
* Train faculty and staff on CPL standards, workflows, and effective support strategies for adult, online, and military-connected learners.
* Work with campus partners to strengthen communication, referral, and support systems related to CPL, career coaching, and student progression.
* Partner with faculty to identify connections between course student learning outcomes and career-relevant skills, helping students articulate how their learning applies to workplace expectations and career goals.
  

  

**Data, reporting, and grant support**

* Maintain CPL and career progression data, prepare reports, and monitor outcomes related to student participation, credit awards, persistence, completion, and use of services.
* Track and assess student engagement and outcomes related to career coaching and CPL utilization, using data to refine programming and inform institutional retention and completion efforts.
* Assist with assessment, documentation, and continuous improvement activities connected to Title III project goals.
* Support institutional reporting and the use of data to improve access, equity, and effectiveness of CPL and career support services.

  
  
  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Two years of experience in higher education, student services, academic advising, career services, adult learner support, registrar functions, workforce development, or a related field.
* Experience with Credit for Prior Learning, prior learning assessment, or transfer credit.
* Experience coordinating programs, managing student support processes, or working across multiple campus offices.
* Strong organizational, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work effectively with adult learners, online students, first-generation students, and military-connected populations.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in higher education, counseling, student affairs, adult education, or a related field.
* Experience supporting online learners, working adults, or military-connected students.
* Familiarity with the Joint Services Transcript, ACE credit recommendations, and VA education benefits.
* Experience using student information systems, case management platforms, or career services technologies.

  
  

**Hours per week:**

Full-Time with On-Campus and Remote work opportunities

  

**Job Posting Date:**

10/10/2026

  

**Priority Deadline:**

10/25/2026

  

**Priority Deadline Information:**

Priority consideration will be given to applications received by the Priority Date; however, applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
